Friend — there are two important things you should know about me:

1\. Coming from 35 generations of Laguna Pueblo women, **I am both of and for New Mexico.** I have never forgotten my roots, and I never will. And I will _always_ fight for our communities.

2\. **I'm not afraid to stand up to Donald Trump** — or anyone else who threatens New Mexican communities and our way of life. I have _many_ times before, and **_t_**** _[hat's what I'll do from day one as our governor, but I need your help to get there.](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/4575?t=2&akid=7151%2E400544%2EyfS7jG)_**
_If you've saved payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:_ | | | [Donate $10](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/4576?t=3&akid=7151%2E400544%2EyfS7jG)

---
Like so many of you, I am furious and heartbroken at what is happening across our country right now. We must continue to fight back, in every way we can. Every one of us has the ability to speak up and to vote out those who are enabling the cruel policies of ICE and the Trump administration. Hope is only lost when resistance stops, and there is real power in our voices and our collective action.

That's why I've joined protesters in Albuquerque and Santa Fe, and it's why I will continue to stand in solidarity with all who oppose injustice, encourage our lawmakers to vote against additional DHS funding, and support efforts to require ICE agents to identify themselves, to remove their masks, and to ban ICE detention centers in our state.
There is no reason for masked men with guns to take away a 5-year-old or leave a 12-year-old brother without a dad or a younger sibling. Under-trained ICE agents should not be brutalizing communities, tearing families apart, or breaking the law. Lawful protesters should never be met with gunfire in the streets. This isn't just unacceptable — it's un-American.

**_Instead of destroying kids' lives, families, and futures, o_**** _ur country should be protecting them_**** _. That is what I will do from day one as our next governor._**
**You have my promise: I will hold Donald Trump accountable and protect New Mexicans _always._ If his administration wants to bring violence and chaos to our state, gut the healthcare and food assistance programs our families rely on, and decimate our public lands, they will have to go through me first.**
While this administration attacks our communities and hands out tax breaks to billionaires, I will fight for an education that gives every child the chance to dream big and reach their full potential here in New Mexico. I'll give families a raise by increasing the minimum wage and the child tax credit. I'll protect affordable healthcare and expand access to treatment and recovery programs for those suffering from addiction.
**But with New Mexico's history of switching parties every eight years and Republicans spending whatever it takes to buy the governor's office, flip our state red, and bring an extremist agenda,****I need you with me to deliver on these promises.
**
**[Please, will you chip in $5, or whatever you can comfortably spare, to help me become governor of New Mexico so I can stand up to Trump, keep our communities safe, and deliver real progress for our families?](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/4575?t=7&akid=7151%2E400544%2EyfS7jG)**
| | [Donate](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/4575?t=8&akid=7151%2E400544%2EyfS7jG)
---
Thank you so much.

Stay fierce,

Deb

Team, I went to Minneapolis to see firsthand what is happening and learn about how this community is coming together after a targeted racist and political attack on its citizens. And let me tell you something, the people of this city are real patriots, American heroes who are fighting for freedom against an oppressive government. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/124235412/597992859/674527589?refcode=260128_sm_cooper&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjUvMS83NDc1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwYjAxOTM2ZS1hN2ZjLWYwMTEtOGQ0Yy0wMDIyNDgyZDI3OWIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=VGuII_yMA2QJHCd-7XC2WV7wmDjDcVhJbjc0uaDKTyo=&emci=b6673beb-98fc-f011-8d4c-0022482d279b&emdi=0b01936e-a7fc-f011-8d4c-0022482d279b&ceid=194769) And when I say oppressive government, I mean it. In fact, I mean something very similar to what happened in Nazi Germany. This administration has normalized government murders and the violation of our constitutional freedoms and rights in a way that is frighteningly similar. They conditioned German citizens to accept the idea that agents of the state could single out certain members of their community, target them, and violate their rights with impunity. That's what's happening today in Minneapolis, but this administration is learning that American citizens will never just lie down and let you strip their freedoms and their rights. This month marked one year since I was sworn in for my second term in Congress. And honestly — it’s been rough.

I’ll always be grateful to you for helping make history by sending the first Gen Z member of Congress to Washington.

Right now, our government is in the hands of extremists and authoritarians who are dragging this country backward. But if we stand together again, we can vote these fascists out of office and finally make our government and economy work for the people.

But who wins will depend on more than just who gets the most votes. In fact, it could come down to decisions being made right now in states across the country. Here’s the situation. Right now, state legislatures and the Supreme Court are making changes to the rules for elections across the country. That includes deciding who’s allowed to vote by mail, and what documents are required to register, or even cast a ballot. Your LCV membership can help ensure these rules — and our elections — are free and fair. Support from LCV members enables our work, and that of our 30 state affiliates, to advocate and lead coalitions across the country to make sure that everyone has fair access to the polls — no matter their race, income, ability, or zip code. And we’re preparing to support one of the biggest voter registration efforts in our history, helping to give everyone a voice in our democracy and ensure that the interests of people, not corporate polluters, shape our future. But all this can only happen with support from LCV members — people like you. name: Steve Daines
subject: Let me explain
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Steve Daines for Montana
body:
Democrats are outspending Republicans by historic margins across the country, in races that wouldn't have been considered battleground races just a few years ago. |
---
Fellow American,

I know this is the time you start receiving a lot of emails about the first End-of-Month fundraising deadline of 2026. Most of the emails will tell you it's an important deadline, but they will rarely explain why these End-of-Month deadlines are so critical to a campaign's success.

**That's why I wanted to take a minute to break down why our Saturday deadline is so important and not just a marketing gimmick.** After you hear my explanation, I hope you'll join our fight by pitching in a few dollars ahead of January 31st.

Democrats are outspending Republicans by historic margins across the country, in races that wouldn't have been considered battleground races just a few years ago. They're relying on a radical base of megadonors and extremist special interest groups to fuel their campaigns.

We don't have their base of extremist megadonors. We're a grassroots-powered campaign. That means, to compete, every ad and voter outreach campaign needs to be carefully planned, budgeted for, and executed. That's where our End-of-Month fundraising deadlines come into play - _especially the first of the Election Year._

Months in advance, my campaign team sets specific monthly fundraising benchmarks to run the ads and target the voters we need to secure victory. These fundraising targets allow my team to plan our winning voter outreach strategy and combat anything the Democrats throw at us.

In a race this expensive and contentious, **[every End-of-Month fundraising deadline counts.](http://links.supportdaines.com/u/click?_t=71faa67ca88f4c4b899697b6a4621901&_m=3a563ef2a32a457cb0a081bd94482b3e&_e=FlZ4zqMfpk4hMyow8hwzVueUmDTsQmzO596S7GcPxvnp2aqqYNq6Mb_74spg_YhwO6AYf4QDyCTF1TbuVrXFuFlTFcelseW_rdUBAtHJ0JuztH4OKtibAde8abDuPVNAoMz8qp5O2dfAu-vILO4zb_JBH_T6chRPKQPxbppr2zNT4J2iyeUIlO2O3XEYebN_YdDXaDNT-eoIx7gQ1742tS2_fs_QmMKG79Yz41m02ZravDp8jxtObIEaQMgd8VsKc8bP9sUJma2lWLJjyEz8IcV1-vA2aF1KEKfy9JMR8Y93EkV9iciRmBNVTTdeogwhQ7xL6aoin-eU-TZzlSqW6nritivSeP1IC9Kcirp6JbS-DfzcXViqxyedyij4E3bIRjWILcQo9GyHYmkYwKB5daFPvyuaPlJY0X_nIuEahN8d-yfTr2UfaXnzLN01lXHFsk2T62EsrJMFK7DXIUqyZ-atATehBJLWuxiD8_wEmLV0NXXIm5G8FLjxllyblXluhqMAXrqPk_7gTtMdwWxO9tzyjN9czVijMLLfRWijO_gFx2pM5RbKUDdaOgF_LNucKca_vCAqM-MMCEY4C--WjTcbmkv348siS1v90maPK0kKq0tGX0eaSDKD-_AG19pmt5L5NITFcMHpg7fsxntkYDmYrbi0DhSBM4cMZP7yEKw9L-7rojzuzG3IdUHWmw-qaHyGpCaPAm8Ruls7AIUyAt5scbODtWDAhQ8bVAq24QIImRW1g2w6kTJOHF1UjpwB)** One down month or a missed deadline could permanently put us on the defensive, jeopardizing our Republican majority.

With a little over 72 hours left before January ends, my team is only $2,030 short of our benchmark. clean_body: Democrats are outspending Republicans by historic margins across the country, in races that wouldn't have been considered battleground races just a few years ago. | Fellow American, I know this is the time you start receiving a lot of emails about the first End-of-Month fundraising deadline of 2026. Most of the emails will tell you it's an important deadline, but they will rarely explain why these End-of-Month deadlines are so critical to a campaign's success. That's why I wanted to take a minute to break down why our Saturday deadline is so important and not just a marketing gimmick. After you hear my explanation, I hope you'll join our fight by pitching in a few dollars ahead of January 31st. Democrats are outspending Republicans by historic margins across the country, in races that wouldn't have been considered battleground races just a few years ago. They're relying on a radical base of megadonors and extremist special interest groups to fuel their campaigns. We don't have their base of extremist megadonors. We're a grassroots-powered campaign. That means, to compete, every ad and voter outreach campaign needs to be carefully planned, budgeted for, and executed. That's where our End-of-Month fundraising deadlines come into play - especially the first of the Election Year. Months in advance, my campaign team sets specific monthly fundraising benchmarks to run the ads and target the voters we need to secure victory. These fundraising targets allow my team to plan our winning voter outreach strategy and combat anything the Democrats throw at us. In a race this expensive and contentious, One down month or a missed deadline could permanently put us on the defensive, jeopardizing our Republican majority. With a little over 72 hours left before January ends, my team is only $2,030 short of our benchmark. I know it doesn't sound like a lot, but with the amount Democrats are spending against us, EVERY dollar matters. Even coming up a few dollars short means critical campaign operations will have to be scaled back. will give my team the resources they need to execute a winning campaign strategy to keep this seat in Republican hands. Thanks for standing with me, Steve Daines P.S. To give an idea of what we're up against. Democrats spent over $90 million in Montana in the 2024 election. The biggest reason we came out on top was because of the support of grassroots conservatives like you. Steve Daines is a fifth-generation Montanan, life-long sportsman and father of four serving the people of Montana as their Senator. body:
I want to explain this to you.
# [](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/35?t=1&akid=2057%2E791427%2E8yfoCe)
[](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/7?c0=io-em-jan26.B2OwkJ&refcode=em260128-2-240&refcode2=2057.791427.8yfoCe&t=2&akid=2057%2E791427%2E8yfoCe)
---
Friend — Ilhan here. This is important.
I’m asking you to **[chip in $10 to my campaign today.**](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/7?c0=io-em-jan26.B2OwkJ&refcode=em260128-2-240&t=3&akid=2057%2E791427%2E8yfoCe) I want to explain why. Please, read on.
**[CHIP IN $10](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/7?c0=io-em-jan26.B2OwkJ&amount=10&refcode=em260128-2-240&t=4&akid=2057%2E791427%2E8yfoCe)**
I’ve been saying for months now that Trump’s constant attacks and racist rhetoric has consequences. **Last night we saw what that looks like.** A man attacked me at a town hall with my constituents.
Look, we have heard it all from Trump and his administration. He called me “disgusting” and “SCUM”. He called me and all Somali-Americans “garbage”. He said that I should be sent back to Somalia. His allies in Congress have threatened to denaturalize and deport me. He and JD Vance have spread horrible, false conspiracies about my family and I to gin up outrage.
All of this has led to an explosion of racist harassment and threats on my life from the far-right. But that’s not all. **Trump’s anti-immigrant fixations guide federal policy under his presidency, and it’s a disaster for America.**
As soon as Trump focused-in on Somali-American people, ICE initiated Operation Metro Surge, and flooded Minnesota with ICE and other immigration agents in an attempt to intimidate and punish the Somali-American community.
When ICE arrived and realized that 99% of Somali-Americans are citizens, they turned to racially-profiling Latino people, Asian people, Black people, and anyone who looked or sounded “not born here” to try to round up undocumented folks.
In the process, they have destroyed any semblance of civil rights. Unlawful searches and seizures have become a daily occurrence. Stopping people in the street, ramming them in traffic, and busting down their doors to detain them without even checking their documentation. US citizens and legal immigrants alike have been arrested and detained for days or weeks, often to simply be released again.
And on top of the unlawful behavior, ICE has demonstrated an outright violent hostility to the people of my district and my state. They’ve beat countless protesters and observers. They’ve tear-gassed school kids and babies. They have abused and humiliated our elders. They’ve murdered two people in cold blood.
These are the devastating consequences of Trump and the far-right’s obsession with Somali-Americans like me. Yes, I have now faced down an attacker, and face down harassment daily. But it’s my community, our safety, our democracy, and the Constitution that has suffered the most.
**Friend, we have a moral and historic obligation to reject Trump’s racism and hatred, reject ICE’s occupation of our state, and save our democracy from these authoritarian thugs.**

subject: I’m *still* sorry about Karoline Leavitt
body:
What do they know about winning in New Hampshire?
| Peter, I’m sorry about Karoline Leavitt. A few years ago, Karoline Leavitt ran against me for Congress here in New Hampshire. Her campaign was steeped in extreme MAGA rhetoric and zero connection to the actual issues Granite Staters face every day. **Voters saw right through it and rejected her agenda by nearly 10 points.** [](https://act.roycooper.com/go/5194?t=2&akid=409%2E124072%2Er919S0) Unfortunately that race turned into a national audition. Now the same talking points and spin that New Hampshire voters dismissed are being used daily from the White House briefing room. So if you’re wondering how the rest of the country ended up having to listen to Karoline Leavitt, it’s because New Hampshire proved something important first: Her extreme ideas don’t hold up when you put them in front of real voters. But that hasn’t stopped the MAGA machine from trying. National Republicans are pouring money into **New Hampshire because they think they can break through and notch a win here to cling to their Senate majority.** They’ve lined up behind John Sununu, an NRSC-backed candidate who will vote with Donald Trump and MAGA leadership when it matters most. name: Mark Kelly
subject: I’m suing Pete Hegseth
body:
Donald Trump and Pete Hegseth want to use the power of the White House and the Department of Defense to silence me because they don’t like what I have to say.
---
Derek, it's Mark. I am suing the Secretary of Defense. After 25 years in uniform and another five in the United States Senate, I never imagined I’d have to do something like this. Hegseth has left me no choice. Donald Trump and Pete Hegseth want to use the power of the White House and the Department of Defense to punish me because they don’t like what I have to say. Their attacks are directed at me right now, but they’re trying to send a message to every retired member of the military: Speak out against us and we will come after you with every tool we have at our disposal. We’ll censure you, we’ll threaten your rank and retirement, and we might even court-martial you. It’s unconstitutional, so I’m suing them. Beyond this lawsuit, it’s important we send a message to Trump and Hegseth to show them just how many people are on this team to defend our constitutional rights. That’s where you come in. I’ve been truly humbled by the support people have sent my way over the past couple of months. It means the world to me that so many of you care about what Trump and Hegseth are trying to do. That’s how we’ve made it this far, and it’s how we’ll get to the other side of this chapter in our nation’s history. Together. If you’ve been waiting for the right time to make a stand and join the fight, this is it. body:
Sending poorly supervised federal agents without the proper training and regulations of our police forces into a city and then demanding unredacted voter data in return is exactly the hostage situation it sounds like. What this means for the upcoming midterms should scare all of us, Team.
Chip in $35 or more right now to help inform voters, get them out to cast a ballot, and defend our fundamental right to vote in every state >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=012826_3&amount=35]
Voter Action Project [https://voteractionproject.org/]
Mother Jones: DOJ’s “Ransom” Letter to Minnesota Reveals How Trump Plans to Rig the Midterms [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=012826_3&amount=25]
This is sickening, Team.
On the same day a masked ICE agent executed Alex Pretti on the street in Minneapolis, Attorney General Pam Bondi sent a letter to Minnesota Governor Tim Walz stating that if he wanted to “ bring an end to the chaos in Minnesota ,” he should comply with some “ common sense solutions .”
What did MAGA Pam Bondi have in mind? For Minnesota to provide the Department of Justice with full, unredacted access to the state’s complete voter roll. "Unredacted" means including sensitive personal information like voters’ Social Security numbers, drivers license data, and party affiliations.
That's right -- the ICE occupation of Minneapolis isn't about immigration at all , but Trump using his personal attack force like a mafia threat to break kneecaps from a bad movie. Thankfully, pro-voting rights leaders in Minnesota are resisting these autocratic, strongman tactics and standing up for our fundamental rights.
We have to stand with Minnesotans and any other state where opponents of voting rights try to replicate this. Step up with $35 or whatever you can today to protect voter data and ensure the midterms are free and fair elections >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=012826_3&amount=35]

States run our elections, not the federal government, even if our Attorney General ( the theoretical top law enforcement officer in the country ) doesn't understand that basic law.
Bondi claimed that the DOJ needed the state’s full voter roll in order to “ confirm Minnesota’s voter registration practices comply with federal law .”
It's all just cover for an outrageous attempt by the Trump administration to coerce Minnesota into providing confidential voter data that would be weaponized by the president and his allies to amplify false claims of voter fraud, wrongly remove eligible voters from the rolls, and challenge election results.
Just last week the MAGA DOJ was forced to admit that DOGE employees entered an illegal agreement to give confidential information from the Social Security Administration to a voter suppression group . Do we really think that the opponents of voting rights who run the Trump administration would do any different with state data?
Every step of the Trump and MAGA plan to suppress the vote is about protecting the power they have and rigging election results in advance by choosing who is worthy of voting. Today, the FBI executed a search warrant at the Fulton County elections office in Georgia, demanding ballots, voter rolls, tabulator tapes, and ballot images from the 2020 election.

# **John Deere Bets Big on Indiana: $125M Distribution Center Planned for Lake County**
[Click Here to Read the Full Story](https://indianarepublicancentralcommittee.cmail20.com/t/y-l-ajllhn-hhlljjcji-y/) Hoosier AG Today
C.J. Miller
January 27, 2026
[https://www.hoosieragtoday.com/2026/01/27/john-deere-facility-lake-county-2/ ](https://indianarepublicancentralcommittee.cmail20.com/t/y-l-ajllhn-hhlljjcji-j/)John Deere has recently broken ground on a $125 million distribution center in Lake County in northwestern Indiana.[Hoosier Ag Today first reported on this project in July 2024](https://indianarepublicancentralcommittee.cmail20.com/t/y-l-ajllhn-hhlljjcji-t/), with John Deere purchasing the property for the site at the time for $7 million.The 1.2 million-square-foot distribution center is being built on 234 acres off of I-65, near the cities of Lowell and Hebron. The facility is planned at 2105 W. 181st Avenue--just southwest of the interchange of I-65 and State Road 2.According to a release from Gov. Mike Braun's office Tuesday evening, the new facility is expected to create 150 jobs, each expected to pay above the county's current average wage."Our state's location as the Crossroads of America makes it the ideal destination for companies of all sizes to serve customers across the U.S. and around the world," said Gov. Braun in a statement. "John Deere's expansion to Indiana is a testament to our business-first environment, our robust manufacturing sector, and our strong pipeline of skilled talent."John Deere says their new facility is strategically located to enhance their supply chain capabilities nationwide, and will be designed to streamline operations and ensure timely delivery of equipment and parts.The company says it will continue to maintain its primary North American Parts Distribution Center in Milan, Illinois, which has been in operation since 1973 and employs about 1,200 people.John Deere adds that its expansion to Indiana is part of their commitment to invest $20 billion in U.S. manufacturing over the next 10 years.The Indiana Economic Development Corp. (IDEC) has committed $2.5 million in incentive-based credits to the project, according to the Governor's Office. The company will be eligible to claim those state benefits once its planned investments are made and employees are hired.President Trump mentioned John Deere's plans during an appearance in Clive, Iowa, on Tuesday. The Indiana facility is one of two that has been announced by the company. John Deere says it also plans to build a $70 million manufacturing facility in Kernersville, North Carolina, that will produce excavators previously produced in Japan. The site of the future 1.2 million square foot warehouse and distribution facility for John Deere. The site is located near the interchange of I-65 and State Road 2 near Lowell in Lake County. [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/TOP%20BLACK%20AF%20Black%20History%20Month%20event%20with%20Michael%20Harriot.jpg]
Join TOP for an inspiring evening with Michael Harriot [https://www.michaelharriot.com/] , best-selling author of Black AF History [https://www.michaelharriot.com/poscasts] , as we celebrate Black history, organizing, and building power for our communities.
This special event coincides with the 100th anniversary of Black History Month and will be held February 24th at Friendship-West Baptist Church in Dallas , so mark your calendars and get your tickets. An RSVP is required to attend this event. Stay tuned for more as we get closer to it!
https://topblackhistorysymposium.rsvpify.com/ [https://topblackhistorysymposium.rsvpify.com/]
Outraged after another brutal murder in Minneapolis by federal agents, and how we can all help
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Alex%20Pretti%20vigil%20MN.jpg]
The murder of Alex Pretti at the hands of federal agents is a watershed moment for our nation. It’s never been clearer that ICE and Border Patrol are being weaponized by Donald Trump to attack entire communities and anyone who opposes their unjust use of force. These agencies are endangering lives and MUST be reigned in. Millions across the country are furious after not only witnessing another state-sanctioned murder, but once more being shamelessly lied to by our government. [https://www.rollingstone.com/tv-movies/tv-movie-news/jon-stewart-alex-pretti-murder-the-daily-show-1235505306/]
The political fallout from this violence is taking shape and must happen to its fullest extent, as Border Patrol Commander-At-Large Gregory Bovino has now been relieved of his post [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cgrdlr70qg4o] and White House officials are discreetly adjusting their tone [https://www.pbs.org/newshour/show/white-house-shifts-response-to-minneapolis-shooting-after-bipartisan-outrage] . Even Greg Abbott, always a MAGA lackey, is distancing himself from what's transpired in Minneapolis. [https://thehill.com/policy/national-security/5707062-texas-abbott-immigration-minnesota/]
This momentum shift IS people-power and solidarity in action. A core value of ours at TOP, we know it's solidarity that will help get us out of this dire time and bring brighter days. That's why we're encouraging you — our members, supporters, and community partners — to donate to community groups offering mutual aid and other services to directly-impacted Minnesotans.
https://www.standwithminnesota.com/ [https://www.standwithminnesota.com/]
Register to vote before the Feb. 2 deadline in Texas
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Smaller%20-%20Texas%20voter%20registration%20card.jpg]
You have less than a week to register to vote in this March's primary elections in Texas! Learn about who and what will be on your ballot here. [https://apps.texastribune.org/features/2026/texas-march-2026-primary-ballot/]
Don't wait until the last minute to register; get it done now. Double-check your voter registration status [https://govotetexas.org/] , and tell your friends and family to do the same!
TRUMP TRACKER:
The president is driving up healthcare costs
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Healthcare%20march.jpg]
Last week, we introduced an antidote, Critical Ignoring [https://www.psychologytoday.com/us/blog/misinformation-desk/202511/critical-ignoring-a-strategy-for-information-overload] , to help us combat Trump and MAGA's strategy of "flooding the zone," [https://www.newsweek.com/steve-bannon-flood-zone-strategy-explained-trump-policy-blitz-2027482] intended to confuse and divide us. This week, we’re keeping our eyes on the prize by focusing on issues that truly impact and matter to our communities — issues like healthcare .
From drastic Medicaid funding cuts, to undermining vaccines, to refusing to extend subsidies for the ACA Marketplace, Trump 2.0 has so far been a complete healthcare disaster for working families. [https://www.protectourcare.org/one-year-in-trump-and-gops-health-care-sabotage-creating-chaos-nationwide/]
Where are we all feeling it the most? Our wallets, as healthcare costs have increased significantly since the start of 2025, with 2026 premiums for ACA plans projected to rise by up to 114% for MILLIONS this year due to expired subsidies.
Are you a Texan with a healthcare story to share? If so, take our survey! [https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfoc1OUiuz2TfuWAMFfFO2p2m3ti1xB9QGZzEjIya3BgLA9EA/viewform]
And while Trump has tried to play up his joke of a healthcare plan [https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/jan/15/trump-healthcare-reform-framework] this month, he might as well have stayed with his "concepts of a plan." [https://newrepublic.com/post/185832/donald-trump-roasted-concepts-plan]

Simposio del Mes de la Historia Negra de TOP con el aclamado autor Michael Harriot
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/TOP%20BLACK%20AF%20Black%20History%20Month%20event%20with%20Michael%20Harriot.jpg]
Únete a TOP para una velada inspiradora con Michael Harriot [https://www.michaelharriot.com/] , autor del libro con éxito de ventas “Black AF History," [https://www.michaelharriot.com/poscasts] mientras celebramos la historia negra, la organización comunitaria y la construcción de poder para nuestras comunidades.
Este evento especial coincide con el centenario del Mes de la Historia Negra y se llevará a cabo el 24 de febrero en la Iglesia Bautista Friendship-West en Dallas . ¡Anota la fecha en tu calendario y consigue tus entradas! Se requiere RSVP para asistir a este evento. ¡Mantente al tanto para más información a medida que se acerque la fecha del evento!
https://topblackhistorysymposium.rsvpify.com/ [https://topblackhistorysymposium.rsvpify.com/]
Indignados tras otro brutal asesinato en Minneapolis a manos de agentes federales, y cómo podemos ayudar entre todos
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Alex%20Pretti%20vigil%20MN.jpg]
El asesinato de Alex Pretti a manos de agentes federales marca un punto de inflexión para nuestra nación. Nunca ha estado más claro que el ICE y la Patrulla Fronteriza están siendo instrumentalizados por Donald Trump para atacar a comunidades enteras y a cualquiera que se oponga a su uso injusto de la fuerza. Estas agencias están poniendo vidas en peligro y DEBEN ser controladas. Millones de personas en todo el país están furiosas tras presenciar otro asesinato sancionado por el Estado y, una vez más, ser descaradamente engañadas por nuestro gobierno. [https://www.rollingstone.com/tv-movies/tv-movie-news/jon-stewart-alex-pretti-murder-the-daily-show-1235505306/]
Las consecuencias políticas de esta violencia están comenzando a manifestarse y deben hacerlo en toda su magnitud, ya que el comandante general de la Patrulla Fronteriza, Gregory Bovino, ha sido destituido de su cargo [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cgrdlr70qg4o] y los funcionarios de la Casa Blanca están ajustando discretamente su discurso [https://www.pbs.org/newshour/show/white-house-shifts-response-to-minneapolis-shooting-after-bipartisan-outrage] . Incluso Greg Abbott, siempre un lacayo de MAGA, se está distanciando de lo sucedido en Minneapolis . [https://thehill.com/policy/national-security/5707062-texas-abbott-immigration-minnesota/]
Este cambio de rumbo es el poder del pueblo y la solidaridad en acción. Un valor fundamental para nosotros en TOP, sabemos que la solidaridad nos ayudará a superar esta difícil situación y a alcanzar días mejores. Por eso les animamos a ustedes, nuestros miembros, simpatizantes y socios comunitarios, a donar a grupos comunitarios que ofrecen ayuda mutua y otros servicios a los habitantes de Minnesota directamente afectados.
https://www.standwithminnesota.com/ [https://www.standwithminnesota.com/]
Regístrate para votar antes de la fecha límite del 2 de febrero en Texas
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Smaller%20-%20Texas%20voter%20registration%20card.jpg]
¡Te queda menos de una semana para registrarte para votar en las elecciones primarias de marzo en Texas! Infórmate aquí sobre quiénes y qué propuestas aparecerán en tu boleta. [https://apps.texastribune.org/features/2026/texas-march-2026-primary-ballot/]
No esperes hasta el último momento para registrarte; hazlo ahora. Verifica tu estatus de registro de votante [https://govotetexas.org/] y dile a tus amigos y familiares que hagan lo mismo.
SEGUIMIENTO A TRUMP:
El presidente está provocando un aumento en los costos de cuidado de la salud
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Healthcare%20march.jpg]
La semana pasada, presentamos un antídoto, la Indiferencia Crítica [https://www.psychologytoday.com/us/blog/misinformation-desk/202511/critical-ignoring-a-strategy-for-information-overload] , para ayudarnos a combatir la estrategia de Trump y MAGA de "inundar el panorama informativo," [https://www.newsweek.com/steve-bannon-flood-zone-strategy-explained-trump-policy-blitz-2027482] cuyo objetivo es confundirnos y dividirnos. Esta semana, mantenemos la vista puesta en lo importante, centrándonos en los temas que realmente impactan y son relevantes para nuestras comunidades, como la atención médica .
Desde los drásticos recortes a la financiación de Medicaid, pasando por el socavamiento de las vacunas, hasta la negativa a extender los subsidios para el Mercado de Seguros Médicos de la Ley de Cuidado de Salud Asequible (ACA), la administración de Trump 2.0 ha sido hasta ahora un completo desastre en materia de atención médica para las familias trabajadoras. [http://www.protectourcare.org/one-year-in-trump-and-gops-health-care-sabotage-creating-chaos-nationwide/]
¿Dónde lo notamos más? En nuestros bolsillos, ya que los costos de la atención médica han aumentado significativamente desde principios de 2025, y se prevé que las primas de los planes de ACA para 2026 aumenten hasta un 114% para MILLONES de personas este año debido a la expiración de los subsidios.
Haz clic aquí si eres de Texas y tienes una historia personal sobre el cuidado de salud que quieras compartir. [https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSf1bY_DlK7WwjhHEWsdJhb8yQSqAUdL3z_EEH_QepPF2HeAEw/viewform?usp=dialog]
¡Queremos escucharte! Además, aunque Trump ha intentado promocionar su ridículo plan de atención médica [https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/jan/15/trump-healthcare-reform-framework] este mes, está claro que debería haberse quedado con sus "ideas para un plan.” [https://newrepublic.com/post/185832/donald-trump-roasted-concepts-plan]

| January 29, 2026

Craig Riedel Officially Files to Run for State Senate District 1

DEFIANCE - Republican State Senate candidate Craig Riedel announced today that he has officially filed his petitions to run for senator in Ohio State Senate District 1. Riedel is running for the seat currently held by term-limited Ohio Senate President Rob McColley (R-Napoleon). Riedel is well positioned to succeed Senator McColley and serve as Northwest Ohio's conservative voice in Columbus.

Since being the first candidate to enter the race in early April, Riedel has worked tremendously hard and has picked up several key endorsements. Along with local endorsements from within the district, Riedel has also received endorsements from statewide organizations like Ohio Value Voters, Associated Builders and Contractors of Ohio, and Americans for Prosperity-Ohio. Riedel's pro-growth business background and staunch conservative principles have made him the clear choice for Republican voters in Senate District 1. Riedel issued the following statement on the campaign:

"Danette and I are incredibly grateful and encouraged by the outpouring of support from the people of Northwest Ohio. Since the beginning of our campaign, we've had the opportunity to knock on more than 11,000 doors, attend events all across the senate district, and meet so many outstanding people who love Northwest Ohio. I look forward to continuing to work extremely hard everyday for the people of the 1st Senate District as their next senator."

The 1st Senate District encompasses all or parts of 10 counties in Northwest Ohio: all of Defiance, Fulton, Hancock, Hardin, Henry, Paulding, Putnam, Van Wert, and Williams Counties, and part of Logan County. Senate President Rob McColley (R-Napoleon) is term-limited in 2026. Craig and his wife of 37 years, Danette, reside in Defiance. They have two children and three granddaughters. Riedel served as State Representative for the 82nd Ohio House District for six years. A civil engineer, he spent 27 years in the steel industry at Nucor Vulcraft Group.

For more information about Craig Riedel and his campaign, visit craigriedelforohio.com.

Inquiries can be sent to: [craigriedelforohio@gmail.com](mailto:craigriedelforohio@gmail.com)

## Trump Sends 'Massive Armada' Toward Iran
President Trump warned Iran that a "massive Armada," led by the aircraft carrier USS Abraham Lincoln, is [heading toward the country,](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkMGupCAURL9GdxhAQVmwmE3verazNHfg2jK5ggHU9Hz9i533B29VSVVSqVN_nvMTAoX4-g0b2rqkOeJVCGvFPNd8bPsFOZaQIRbMIR2F3i7NkkvNuGDSzB4Cveeh9XZBlNi3aMWojZ6GUal2tdI7ocQEagHeKxgXVMagNoY7dG5wbbB3GxfSCMGV6js-chTSa-cmreTUNwNHH2rK3b8UYl1xoXc6MXcubS3Ztda9NP2vRj4a-biuq4t_3U1x57eTMvlGPm6Gb2HxcISQmUcg9sFkkDfwwMoa9sJOjPj_QAJ2hkQYHbLsIkil5TS22fr9CkSh6LEZ-GuDQJ8x9UcPnlZ-BQAA__-KEoe-) threatening that any future attack would be "far worse" than last June's bombing campaign if Iran didn't negotiate a nuclear deal. The carrier strike group arrived in the Middle East on Monday with three accompanying destroyers, adding some 5,000 American troops to the region where more than 30,000 U.S. service members are already stationed across multiple bases. Trump said the fleet was larger than the one he [sent to Venezuela](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LEO2yAYBOCnwRsR_BhsDwyVKm-punW0CPy2_wpDBCSR375yXqHzSaf77s99uTuKlLZf7kDb1rwk_NSIrWFZWnkdz48rqVJxqWKh_Krx9HkBAYYLyWFagqN4Ln0X7IoIqDq0cjCTGftB6263j1UPoA2AXI3SHicTlFZa9Q8xTCB8R_ZqExImKYXW6iYGgRKC8X40GkbFeoGBWi63v5lS23GNZ35jufl8dNHurT0rUz8YzAxm9_CX4LblK2Yw_86RGvnKYP56-OFqpTdyVw4XHN_RBUobv4j8i-WNDuTllRKljcFcWy4nUzMFpn5KmIzSZtRdseH5oRipmoH1Yjscxe-k9l8_vi38CwAA___1b4df) and warned it is "ready, willing, and able to rapidly fulfill its mission, with speed and violence, if necessary" following protests in Iran that killed thousands. Iran's mission to the United Nations responded that the country stands ready for dialogue based on mutual respect, but "if pushed, it will defend itself and respond like never before." [Oil prices rose](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkD2OgzAUhE9jOpD9wD8pXGxDl223RI79CG9lMLKdIG6_IlfYbqSRvtE3P_fp7ijS9vx2K9o6p2nDo0SsFfNU82vdD5e3QtltBTOlV4mnTxNwUC0XLdym4Cie09AEOyMC9g1aodVNmUFL2SxWu1nKITy00VKqIRiu-YObwPveeHDQkL1oXMBNCC5l33HNUUBQ3hslwfRs4Bioptz9JtrqgnM80xtz59PaRLvUuhfWfzEYGYzHcXR-e_irZDBeaAYjF1c2DMZEsd0zeSxtTcGd7UeyvQS7pa6xyTbsB8VIRWk28OfqKH6W6r_ueVv4CwAA__-VrnfV) 1.23% on the news of escalating tensions.
## States See Shift as US Population Growth Slows
The U.S. experienced its [slowest population growth since 2021](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkM2O3CAQhJ8G3xjxY7A5-BAp8m1zzdFioD10gmEEPevM20feV9hj_1Tpq_r9sX14zFgev_wBC-11K3D2DETQNmqv43n6Vjo2Xzo0rK-e36FuSijLheTKbdFjfm_jEJcdQIEeYJGTdXYeJ2OGtMxOOjHZPdyFUwqC2e9yBKutdqNzdzngcrkJqZyUwhh9E5MAqaINYbZGzZqNAiJSbbc_FQsl2PO7fkK7hXoMeUlEz870D6ZWplZKkDDn68bUmuoBVyCm1gL_Ovm2HRDRbyc2YGo1k5iN0ZwS8E6eoPNHqyeWB_cl8p4alr_XdD3svhN04j6E2uLXtvIApb86h054XPqLQq90b7Az_TM9h7bE54k5Y7cTG8Xj8PhFN9C36v5c1P8AAAD__5-dlww), increasing by just 0.5% between July 2024 and July 2025 due to a decline in net international migration that dropped from 2.7 million to 1.3 million people, according to just-released census estimates. Within the U.S., some states lost population and some gained. South Carolina led the nation with the fastest growth rate at 1.46%, followed by Idaho, North Carolina, Texas, and Utah, while Texas gained the most residents in raw numbers with over 391,000 new people. Five states saw their populations decline, with Vermont dropping the fastest at 0.29%, followed by Hawaii, West Virginia, New Mexico, and California, though California's decline of 9,000 people was the largest drop of any state in absolute numbers. Since 2020, Texas has added nearly 2.5 million residents while California has lost more than 170,000, with experts attributing the shifts to cost of living, job opportunities, and changing immigration patterns. [See a map here](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLHO4yAQhJ_G7rBgjbFdUFyTLtdeaSFYx9xhsNhNUN7-lLzCX89oNN_3577dXUwxP367Ey3vZcvYKCEz1o3r87yaq5lidZmwxvKk9PZlAwlGSCVg3YKL6b3pPtgdEXDs0arZrGbR8zT1h131OI4SlV_0sk7Oa78jyoALGjMjyD7az5pUsColp2kc5CxRQTDeL2aCZey0xBC51OFviZkP3NO7vLAOvpx9sgfzRd34q4NbB7fW2vBBaIj_PoUObqe7BB2lkSB2jCRSoZgfgg8UZyEWF5YroXDelxq-SREZm_CY6UkiOHZCKQ0GlOyrDVeLKUUyc6fl43QxfZ_wj_S9LPwPAAD__7jThjs).
## Details Unveiled for New 'Trump Accounts'
President Trump [unveiled Trump Accounts](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGSsyAURp8GOx24KCYFxd_Y5W-3dAhczd1BcABlffud5BW2_-Y7c87XY34Y8hTW_2ZDXZY4B6zZYymY5pKOba8mhUzJhIyJ4pH9ZeMMHFTLRQv32Rny19w3Ti-IgLJBLUZ1V7d-HIbmpUFIDkpx6cRTWuUkWtfz8cmXJ3colob0-40LuAvBh0F2fOQowClrb2qAm2Q9R0clpu47UigvXPwVT0ydjVvj9auUPTP5j8HEYKq1dp5ODLEu8ec9YTBtMeDFYPoItcbaeISS22xOCmtu9xTXZLYmabdX8p6yGlnP182Q_0DKn8qcGn4DAAD__5m6ejY) on Wednesday, a program that will deposit $1,000 into government-funded investment accounts for American children born between Jan. 1, 2025 and Dec. 31, 2028, with funds available beginning at age 18 for education, housing, or starting a business. The accounts will be stock-market linked, with families, employers, churches, and states able to contribute up to $5,000 annually in pre-tax dollars. Trump said modest contributions could grow the accounts to $50,000 or more by age 18. Billionaires Michael and Susan Dell [pledged $6.25 billion](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL2unTAQhJ8GOh_ZBvNTuEhDd9OmRL72ApsYL7IX0Hn7iCPlCVJNMdKn-ebX1_zlMGJaf7odLC80J7hLBGbIM-dzP26XU8HsUoGMdJb49jRrqTshldDjHBzG99zWwS4AGpoarOq7sRva3ph6s9I0IJVe-rZvdIBvaaTp1DL4tpfNAmON9qFJpUelpDHNS_YSlA6d90Nn9NBUrYSATPn1mzDxBkt80wX55Wmvo92Yj1I1Pyo9VXr64_h6ikpPj8kTjpGSuCnHUOnpIyWc93QmFhvFALkIT2cMYgUW5yGYhJJS8EZncSmIQDG6XMSNvAlPiTN-nw-0iOIuTGv5x6uzDceNMWLp-qqV6-4wfnbyf517Wf03AAD__7jrkf0) to provide an additional $250 to 25 million children under 10 in lower-income ZIP codes, while rapper Nicki Minaj announced she would contribute $150,000 to $300,000 for her fans' accounts.

## NASA Plane Makes Emergency Landing
A NASA high-altitude research aircraft made a [safe emergency landing](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLGOtCAUhZ8GOwxcFaSg-Bu7-dstDcpVSRAMMOP49hsnu0-w9b3fyfnO12N8GOddWP-bHXV5L3EMeGaPpWAacce0Ypgvb4J1YXUzWpfn-ByBgaCMU1CjNc5fY1tZPTGreIWaS6FE3zPJqk13inU9TKYV3LIelk5KYWHiAuwCHFnl9B3GOCgOjLO2tgo7AJAAskWAnrQMrSsx1WXDgm-TF3_FF6Z6jnvl9VbKkUnzj8BAYDjPs563FMN9JTDcOgSGLT5ziYF-eAKDScXNHu8Hkw09vAlIJ_T-oj-y9BcB3vAeGlUf21ElbY_Tee-ykKRl626c__Qof1vvpeE7AAD__3gxg6Y) at Ellington Field in Houston on Tuesday after its landing gear malfunctioned. Both crew members were unharmed. Phone [video](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLGS4yAQRL8GZbhgPBYiILhE2V56oWoMI4u6MbgkvFr9_ZW27g827q7ufv3nY_qgLLk8ftOTQ_ua61R434Rb43XiJ68PLvEQKimXR46c8hbrewIDvTZWg58SZTkm7FK4m-Rtx8G63vfDYJzplmABr2TROe4RYfbRze463zwSIM5m6HI4w4wFb8FYg5fk-QYADsAhAwwKDafc6nppCzf-om2Wo37yeon12UlYWntt6vpLwahg3Pf98nep71NUMNLachRWMJ5cCkapkUTByHJit1r0nFmSLrSRfgkV1ncWOfR_Zr3U93bavpsVjDDctKFbf-ceNJuYNOLgNaEdtL0ahhi9IeRuDem1Z5G89U6heTwpy_fk9rOjPwP8CwAA__9ziY_Z) of the harrowing landing shows smoke and flames trailing the aircraft as it skidded down the runway. The jet-powered WB-57 has been used for atmospheric research missions since the early 1970s. It can reach altitudes of 63,000 feet, has a range of 2,500 nautical miles, and can stay airborne for more than six hours. NASA operates three of the aircraft out of Ellington Field. It's unknown what caused the landing gear to stop working. "_NASA will lead a thorough investigation_ ," [said](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0DGOgzAQBdDTQGdkTxwMhYtt6LLtlmjAA1hrDPI4Idx-Ra6w5Wikr__-z6N_oA8-zt-4ks3vaesjHRwoZ0o9rZRmiuMZMDofZz-S8zxuzx4k1EIqAW3v0Iez16Wzg3StKskqU7d100gjy8USKD0MN3PXpgHTQqOaSQ-gJ4ftgEqW3l5hUkGrQCqpK9fSHQAMgNEE0BRakvN5S1VeKNMbeQrn9qJUjdtaBrvkvHNx-yqgK6A7jqOatveluP4FdE8uoIvIKBIxYRoXsQeMJC4Vi4FCOAXTRyh4x_TLYgrndeGUKYmVxgWjHzEIz_ykMlm3Hz4Ez7UptJxX9OFTJv9vwpeFvwAAAP__V4-H_A) spokesperson Bethany Stevens, adding the agency "_anticipates no impact to Artemis II operations_."
## Coffee Shop Manager Quits Over ICE Discount
A Dallas-based coffee shop was [mired in controversy](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLGypCAQRb8GMyxsUSQg2MRsNt3QaqFRqhCmlBnHv9_yvfcHL-6-p-65_x7TA0MMafmLG5ny8XlKdB6RSqF9oo32hZK9IiYX0hIsuXDY_JpAQM9Fw0FPDkO8Jlk5Mwunm4pMo3rdD4NQolpNiwQWsINZi0GA8NgDteBk27cz2qYK5oaJBnQDohGydpo6AFAAShLAwKQgF0re67JSoQ8ePl75TXtt81ZFs5byPFj7h8HIYDzPsz494n1kMOJego3EYLy9GIwxW4wMRocx4sFtfqVy3bk1FOL7GlLmNntPxH9egiWOC6XCv-VTObhFfzNhUJysV7oj4JK05LLrOo5AM0fyVpBEBfNc7cY9zxBjOHrFpFg2DPGrfvnd6G8D_wMAAP__SjiVHQ) after a dozen employees resigned over a policy they assumed required them to give ICE agents a discount intended for local first responders. After a shooting at the ICE detention facility in Dallas last September, the manager of a nearby White Rhino coffee shop decided not to give the discount to agents. "_I made that a store policy to keep us safe_ ," [said Margot Stacy](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkL3O4yAURJ8Gd1j4hvinoEhjaYtsmS0tDBf7ShiyQOL47VfOPsLXjTTS0cz5c5_umjyF5bfeUJWPi1PAPXssBdOEG6YFgzm8DpbCQgYtZRNfEwhouWg4DJPV5I9JVlbNwg5Nharp2qHte9GJalUX14lZXs1Fmvna22GW0rbSiL5tYTbgKlInTDQwNCAaIWs74BUAOoBOIkDPpEBLJaa6rFjwo7PzR3xjqk3cKq_WUp6ZXW4MRgbjvu_1lsPZMRgx8FdmMJ6nGIzfvK9UkKeVQuQmOofIySDXC4aSuY2BF_73pT25g7uYuKOUC0-YnzFYTPy_glBOlk78dmse8-PXXCVlnzt5T7ntmBTLpsl_J5afiX0r-BcAAP__uv-OcA), explaining that the store gets "_a lot of Muslim and Hispanic customers, people who only speak Spanis_ h." Following the shooting of Renee Good in Minneapolis earlier this month, Stacy was told employees could not deny service to ICE agents. Shortly thereafter, store managers were directed to offer the first-responder discount to ICE agents, [prompting Stacy to quit](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0L1ywyAQBOCnQR2a44z1U1CkUee0KTVInKSbIHAAW_bbZxLnDdJ_s7O7H5fxYtlzWN_tTqY8ljgGOrKnUiiNtFNaKcxPb4PjsPJMjvMcbyMCNhKUxH50lv1z1JUzE7heVWRU2_RN10EL1WYAUC0TON0tfW-dVstMpCbdwRnRWl2x-QkDhb1CUKBr19MZEVvEVhNiJzSQ4xJTXTYq9LB58c94p1TPca-82Uq5ZnF6EzgIHI7jqJ313uY4ZUp_TOCwxOikSxw-BQ4vIY-NC8m0cYhyt8GulOTXjUuWPJN8bQ1FamhOrQIUOFTJuOvB3nNuWqFh3S373yLlf_fdDX4HAAD__wv6hOg) and speak out on social media. "_I wasn’t going to compromise my moral standpoint in a company whose only moral was profit_ ," Stacy said. White Rhino has [since clarified](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0LGOqzAQheGnMR1oPDgYChe3octtt0RezwAjGYyMNyRvv0peYesjfUf6v-7T3UuUffnvN3blOadp5-uMXArniTfOC-_hFf1Osi8SmOQM6WdCwK4GXeMwkZf4mkxF7hto0BU7bbuh63uwUK2OOmsNemp164FvwPPcDdpooIGIGCtxbww0DhpBg2lo4BsiWkRrGLFXBpikpNyUlQs__TnHV3pwbkLaqujWUo5Ttf8UjgrH67qasOa0v1eF45wSKRx9LhIiKxwlcP1RavIx-rNG3eq-t6Y51qPKjo5LYpSzs8rAsnmJn5_ytzoPh78BAAD__-79eAw) that the discount is "_only for uniformed, on-duty local first responders_."

---
| Friend,
Are you angry yet? You should be.
The Trump administration's killers have claimed another life. Earlier this month, ICE agents shot and killed Renee Good -- a poet, a wife, and a mother of three. On Saturday, they killed Alex Pretti, an ICU nurse at the VA and a protester demanding accountability.
Two lives, two families shattered. And a rogue gang of masked killers that believe they can murder American citizens with impunity.
After Alex Pretti was killed, Trump promised a "very honorable and honest investigation." But here's the reality: the Minnesota Bureau of Criminal Apprehension and the FBI have been locked out. ICE is investigating itself. Evidence has not been properly preserved. And we still don't even know the name of the agent who pulled the trigger.
---
| [](https://zzejj9hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001RxIB6KHJpjboRTvMwuhVoXAKxwr-n8zdneLj6WeIxdgEkWWTKYV15OvnX_kzxZ3LZcCo0-4JI6Dc_MaFkLyKx-LlOppLhK8pyrKy-71JfWeZefeYAqqHRQL8Lsd9nP2GU045nf-fvOlkLHTfiVtslKN7A7pogQPSEr_FwgkeE-nn6QcBiZ_Q_jF5bp66WxsBYifM6fzOylzcQc76yLak-OavBoso51goVbymMfuFGtc8_-NbSbO5qtkMs4C5lOHDbI7m8nj5LtU=&c=74kdjVZLeBfHpMdKVXHDUE2JjaeyAoXweZH8tjcp-WmiQn6LPkPGAw==&ch=zAJh6QSS_amC3ovxfPaT6fe-wLe3ti1miSKJxFeqde6t4PJ5xTLnXw==)
---
Trump is covering up the murder of Americans by his personal Gestapo. The blood is on his hands.
Despite what J.D. Vance and others are claiming, there is no such thing as "absolute immunity" for ICE agents.
We cannot allow ICE to get away with murders of American citizens in broad daylight. If ICE agents aren't brought to justice, they will kill again.
That's why Defend Our Courts' mission has never been more urgent.
Justice for Renee and Alex is not coming from Washington. It will come from strong, independent state Supreme Courts.
DHS and the Trump admin are doing everything they can to protect the murders at a federal level. But ICE agents can be prosecuted in state courts for violating state law. And critically, any consequences imposed at the state level are beyond the reach of a presidential pardon.
This is how we bring justice for Renee Good and Alex Pretti.

| | Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw

Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

| **This is not rhetoric for me.**

As Attorney General, I led the fight to pass the GIRLS Act. That law protects athletic opportunities for girls and women, and it ensures a level playing field for female athletes.

Because of the GIRLS Act, Arkansas secured fairness in women’s sports and gave the Attorney General’s Office the authority to enforce the law and hold schools accountable.

**Now this issue is back in the spotlight.**

We're waiting on a ruling from the U.S. Supreme Court that could have serious consequences for women’s sports nationwide.

_The ruling will matter, and it will take leaders who are willing to stand firm and act._

I have been clear from the beginning, and I will not back down now.

**Boys do not belong in girls’ sports, and Arkansas should never be forced to abandon common sense.**

As we approach our January end of month fundraising deadline, I am asking you to stand with me and help ensure I have the resources to keep fighting for these values.

# **Ending Political Games**
Far too often, the halls of Congress are marked by partisan discord and unproductive debates, leaving important issues unresolved and the voices of everyday Americans unheard. I believe good leadership means understanding the real needs of our communities, not playing political games.When I have the honor of serving in Congress, rest assured, I won't play political games—I'll be the type who listens attentively to the needs of our communities.By talking openly and working together, we can find solutions to our biggest problems and create an environment of open communication, ensuring that every constituent's perspective is valued.**We CAN forge a path toward a brighter future for all Americans.****_I invite you to support in any way you can as we collectively strive for a better, more representative TX-8._**

**HB1284:** This bill administratively consolidates six Mississippi community and junior college districts into three larger districts, restructures their governing boards, and transfers all assets, duties, and financing to the successor districts without closing campuses.
### **Full Analysis**
_A vote for this bill is a vote to reduce duplicative community college administration, rationalize district boundaries and boards, and modestly streamline the state 's two‐year college system without directly increasing taxes or spending._
#### **Key Provisions & Tradeoffs**
* Consolidates Coahoma into Mississippi Delta, Meridian into East Mississippi, and Southwest into Copiah-Lincoln, cutting the number of community/junior college districts from 15 to 12 effective July 1, 2027.
* Creates successor boards of trustees for the consolidated districts, sets appointment structures and staggered terms, and abolishes the former district boards with all real and personal property transferred to the new entities.
* Directs the Mississippi Community College Board to oversee and, if needed, force administrative consolidation, while specifying that no colleges or instructional facilities must close beyond unneeded administrative offices.

#### **Liberty Analysis**
From a limited-government and fiscal perspective, this bill moves in a generally positive direction. By consolidating six community college districts into three, it reduces the number of separate administrative entities, boards, and overhead structures. While the bill does not hard-code specific spending cuts, it clearly targets duplicative administrative offices and centralizes administration in fewer locations, which is the most likely place to achieve savings. It also clarifies that each county can support only one community college district with its millage, reducing overlapping claims on local tax bases and some structural inefficiency in how support is organized.

On the other hand, the bill does not shrink the overall footprint of public higher education or return resources to taxpayers; it mainly restructures governance. The number of trustees in some consolidated districts is actually quite large, and the statute gives the Mississippi Community College Board fairly strong authority to impose consolidations and property transfers if local districts do not comply. That is a centralizing move within the public system, though it remains confined to administration and does not expand regulatory or enforcement powers over private actors. No new taxes or fees are created, and no new standing entitlement-style spending is mandated; funding remains via existing mechanisms, albeit with clarified boundaries and responsibilities.

From a liberty lens, this is an internal government reorganization that modestly trims duplication and may reduce long‐run administrative costs, without directly impacting parental rights, civil liberties, or private property outside the current public college system. It falls short of deep reform (such as privatization or significant spending rollback), but the direction of travel is toward somewhat leaner and more rational public administration rather than an expansion of mandates or spending. That justifies a modestly positive rating.

The Supreme Court case [Trump v. Slaughter](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/ff4bf98c-b772-4119-b00e-c496b07f32eb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) is as a pivotal moment that could dismantle over a century of unchecked growth in the administrative state. The case stems from President Donald Trump's attempt to remove Federal Trade Commission (FTC) Commissioner Rebecca Kelly Slaughter without cause, challenging longstanding statutory protections that limit presidential removal power to specific grounds like inefficiency or malfeasance.

At the heart of the dispute is the 1935 precedent Humphrey's Executor v. United States, which upheld "for-cause" removal restrictions for heads of independent agencies like the FTC. This decision allowed Congress to insulate certain bureaucrats from at-will firing, creating what critics call an unaccountable "fourth branch" of government. Over decades, the administrative state has expanded dramatically: Congress delegates legislative authority to agencies, which then interpret laws, issue regulations (quasi-legislative), and enforce them through administrative courts (quasi-judicial).
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack.com/redirect/2/eyJlIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9oZWFydGxhbmRqb3VybmFsLnN1YnN0YWNrLmNvbS9zdWJzY3JpYmU_.ufKuOxY5cgOk-pV8wUT3hxO-rycdxPLehIBtWxIfCsM?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=186198178)
Seila Law LLC v. Consumer Financial Protection Bureau (591 U.S. 197, decided June 29, 2020) is a landmark Supreme Court case that significantly chipped away at the foundations of independent agencies, making it a direct precursor to the ongoing Trump v. Slaughter case challenging removal protections for Federal Trade Commission (FTC) commissioners.
These unelected officials wield immense power with little direct accountability to elected leaders or voters.The author contrasts this with the Founders' vision, citing Alexander Hamilton and James Madison in the Federalist Papers. They argued for vesting executive power in a single, elected president to ensure accountability--power must flow from the people through elections, not accumulate in permanent bureaucracies.During oral arguments on Monday (December 8, 2025), Justice Neil Gorsuch captured the constitutional concern succinctly: "There is no such thing in our constitutional order as a fourth branch of government that's quasi-judicial and quasi-legislative."

Gorsuch's remark underscores the view that independent agencies undermine separation of powers by blending functions while evading presidential oversight.

Affirming broad presidential removal authority would restore democratic control. If the Court overrules or significantly limits [Humphrey's Executor](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/8fd36610-9109-4536-bf33-840f64f7b15f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), it could curb bureaucratic overreach, making agencies more responsive to elected officials. Elections would regain meaning, as presidents could align executive actions with voter mandates rather than inheriting entrenched, opposing bureaucracies.

Conversely, upholding insulation would entrench a system where "experts" rule permanently, rendering voting superficial. This leads to policy inertia, unaccountable decisions in critical areas like economy, health, and foreign affairs, and the erosion of self-government. A bureaucracy-dominated government is not a republic but an oligarchy of administrators.

Trump v. Slaughter is a profound choice: reaffirm the Constitution's structure, where expertise advises but voters ultimately rule through revocable authority, or allow bureaucratic permanence to overshadow the revolutionary principle of popular sovereignty.

In essence, the case is the first opportunity in decades to reverse a century-long drift toward unaccountable governance, potentially revitalizing constitutional democracy by reasserting presidential accountability over the executive branch.

body:

Please read the message below from our sponsor.
* * *
| | | [](https://trk.mg.swampdigest.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t9mryu&__onlt=h)
---
| | Friend,
---
| | Charlie would have wanted you to have this.

Before his September 10th assassination, Charlie had just put the finishing touches on a very important book. His final book.

The topic is one that Charlie found to be crucial for every human to understand and practice.

This isn’t a book about public policy or political discourse, nor is it simply about passing on values of patriotism to young Americans.

**Instead, this book is about something far deeper and more personal — the importance of honoring the Sabbath and resting in God’s grace.**

Despite his hectic schedule and full life, Charlie was committed to setting aside an entire day each week to rest, to pray, and to give undivided attention to God, Erika, and his children.

By honoring the Sabbath, Charlie lived out a powerful message: _**“God, You are enough. And because You are enough, I need not carry the weight of a world that was never mine to hold.”**_

His book, _**Stop, in the Name of God**_ is the fruit of that conviction.
---
[](https://trk.mg.swampdigest.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t9mryu&__onlt=h)
---
When you read it, you will hear Charlie’s voice inviting you to reclaim something our fast-paced culture has essentially erased: a time for rest, a time devoted to God, and time with family.

Charlie’s hope was for each of us to rediscover the Sabbath as he did: not as a burden to bear, but as a gift to receive...

A sacred routine meant to draw us nearer to God, to steady our hearts with His peace, and renew our strength for the battles to which He calls us.

I believe you will find this book inspiring.

Charlie wanted everyone to have this book because its message meant so much in his own life.

**[To claim your copy of this life-changing book, simply make a generous gift in any amount to Turning Point USA today.](https://trk.mg.swampdigest.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t9mryu&__onlt=h)**
---
[ **Support Turning Point USA**
**& Receive Charlie’s Final Book**](https://trk.mg.swampdigest.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t9mryu&__onlt=h)
---
In the months since Charlie’s assassination, there has been a massive surge of interest in Turning Point USA’s message among young Americans...

...and it’s not just the conservative message as a whole — _**it’s the message of FAITH!**_

In recent months, I have heard countless stories of people who have answered Charlie’s call to attend a Bible study, start a family, and pray to God.

Charlie devoted so much of his time urging people to build strong families, to go to church, and to stand up for America. _And it’s happening._

After years of witnessing declining church attendance, we are now seeing Americans filling the pews in huge numbers across the country.

What we’re witnessing is not just growth —**it’s revival.**

At Turning Point USA, we are dedicated and honored to continue strengthening the faith of Americans, young and old.

We are building a coalition of truth-preaching churches that stand firm against cultural compromise, defend biblical values, and strengthen families.

We are training pastors, uniting congregations, and, of course, reaching the next generation on campuses across the country with this same message.

You might feel disheartened by the evil in our culture and by the unthinkable assassination of Charlie.

**But America’s faithful are waking up. The youth are waking up. America is waking up.**

All across this nation, pastors are linking arms, young believers are finding their voice, and families are saying, _“We’re not backing down.”_

This is what Charlie prayed for.

I see this book as one of Charlie’s most enduring gifts to the world, and I know you will too.

None of us knew how brief his time on earth would be. But the truths written in this book are timeless. They will outlive us all, and most importantly, **_so will the legacy of Charlie’s faith._**

Charlie lived life at a relentless pace, but he also understood the sacred value of stillness. Through it all, his gaze was fixed on eternity with God.

**[To claim your copy of Charlie’s final book, simply make a gift, in any amount, to support Turning Point USA today.](https://trk.mg.swampdigest.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t9mryu&__onlt=h)**

---
I’ll personally ensure your copy is sent to you as soon as possible.

Thank you in advance for carrying on Charlie’s mission and supporting his legacy.
---
**For Charlie,**

**Justin Streiff**
Chief Operating Officer
Turning Point USA

clean_body: Our message to Congress: No More Money for Destruction and Death | | | Peter, Last week, the House narrowly passed an appropriations bill that would renew ICE’s excessive budget, with no strings attached, adding to the over $170 billion in taxpayer funds already allocated for immigration enforcement in July 2025. The bill increases ICE’s detention budget from $3.4 billion to $3.8 billion and its enforcement budget from $5.08 billion to $5.45 billion. Last year, Congress passed a reconciliation bill that gave ICE a $20 billion increase per year until 2029 — this new bill adds billions more. That’s billions of American people’s hard-earned tax dollars being used to pay for these horrendous actions while occupying American cities. We have one message for Congress: No More Money for Destruction and Death. UWD community members have sent more than 6,800 letters to the U.S. Senate, insisting that they reject the House bill and stop our tax dollars from funding an agenda of destruction and death. We’re calling on them to vote NO on any additional funding for DHS. Your support fuelsour vital work, like this major campaign. Hi Peter I'm Scott Kelly - former NASA Astronaut, retired U.S. Navy Captain and resident of CO district 4.
I've been to space 4 times and spent nearly a year on the International Space Station (ISS). I commanded both the Space Shuttle and the ISS and flew with more than 40 people from across the world--scientists, engineers, doctors--men and women of every background, faith, and nationality. We didn't share the same backgrounds, but we shared a mission: work together, stay focused, and deliver.
That's the kind of leadership and focus we need in Congress. That's what Trisha Calvarese brings to the table.
I'm proud to endorse Trisha Calvarese in Colorado's 4th District.
Trisha is running to defeat Lauren Boebert - and I'm proud to endorse her in this critical mission.
Trisha grew up here on the rural Eastern Plains and in Douglas County. She served our country as a civil servant and returned home to care for her sick parents at the end of their lives. She understands the people of this district because she's actually one of us. She's running for Congress to stand up for the dignity and care of families in her hometown.
That means protecting Social Security and Medicare. It means working to bring down the cost of everything from prescription drugs to groceries. It means investing again in U.S. science and engineering to create good-paying jobs and opportunities. Trisha's ready to actually show up, listen and deliver for folks in her district.
But while Trisha is advocating for you, Lauren Boebert is spending her time making headlines, avoiding her constituents, and voting to gut the programs Coloradans rely on. That's why I'm counting on you to join me in supporting Trisha's campaign to defeat Boebert.
But grassroots campaigns like this one aren't easy. And right now Trisha is counting on our help to raise the $10,000 she needs to build the early infrastructure it takes to win races like this.
[So, friend, I'm personally asking: Will you chip in $25 or more today to help Trisha Calvarese defeat Lauren Boebert, take back the House for Democrats and give working families the voice they deserve in Congress?](https://eub669hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0013aBRL86V5hvTV_J8AAGO6t_vKXbWwn58UQq9oApUrS70ZPR_ZMV27VSOZky5jHTL7CXb3ZXw8EzwjXph1AiMx-OXoDa0HOiDl3DWWv5NBq7JQZQHMuBIxb8eCnDvWSQwPlZj7Jn3WmRgJQ6SATK-k0OzCJlxVjETDIQYapOsm76cOb7Xw6r7nER1Gq6uzYe-n_fduT8adzJk7mhuY7A5VAIWFpe5dVY7A6FfAzv4Of85XaAYjud_qw==&c=qdi8W7Vn8iDDNVzYStQGgho5r8woZPQUvtLPm6rWypxqE_C-VfCk5g==&ch=fZYoqiNeMA0y5QoaQKeQ3vtSP_iwioj-Av_9GU9-wIfnmmZa_pgAdw==)

Check it out...
Governor Little's in DC right now at a Trump event supporting the "one big beautiful bill."
[| | | | | Brad Little
---
@GovernorLittle
Excited to be in Washington, D.C. today for the Trump Accounts Summit. These investments will help ensure every American child gets an early financial foundation, jump-starting their savings and paving the way for future success.🇺🇸
| 10:07 PM * Jan 28, 2026 * 1.88K Views15 Replies * 3 Reposts * 31 Likes
---](https://substack.com/redirect/ce039fea-08ad-4eb6-ac43-e62e7ddbf527?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
And his staff? They're in the Idaho Capitol telling our legislature NOT TO conform to the tax cuts in that same bill.
You can't make this up.
Maybe you've heard the news: Idaho's got a budget crisis. We're upside down and have to make serious cuts. But the governor won't touch education spending. Nope. It's a $5+ billion blob that just keeps growing while he flies to Washington for photo ops and his people contradict everything he claims to support back home.
Pick a lane. You're either with Trump's tax cuts or you're not.
Here's what I want to talk about. If we're really in a budget crisis, why are we protecting every dollar of government education spending like it's sacred? Why won't anyone talk about the programs we could cut tomorrow?
Idaho Launch spends $77 million a year for free college. Yes, we're paying for adult college education with taxpayer money. In a budget crisis, that should be one of the first things on the chopping block. Gone.
Or what about the "Idaho Career Ready Students" program? That was just**** created in 2023 (I voted against it). They sold it as a targeted $45 million one-time fund for rural career techincal programs. Four months later, schools requested $111 million. So, of course, the legislature topped it off with another $20 million in 2024 (I voted against that too):
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/8e93a677-8caf-446a-b7b9-055ee543e048?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Fast forward to 2026 and we've got $70 million committed across 140 proposals with $5 million in ongoing operational costs locked in forever. Even with Idaho facing a $555 million budget deficit for FY 2027, this program is completely untouchable.
Why?
Because you can't shut down welding labs that kids are already enrolled in without every rural superintendent showing up with students talking about how you're killing their community's workforce programs.
_**Once you create beneficiaries and build expectations, the spending becomes "permanent."**_
This is exactly why I voted no. You don't start programs you can't sustain, and you definitely don't start programs where demand will always exceed supply by 2-3x.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/2bf2c305-b705-4048-9e20-0004b76f9cbd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
And then there's Idaho Public Television.
The new education budget includes $4,178,400 for public TV. We're funding television through the education budget. I was the only senator who voted against it last year (when they wanted $4,089,300):
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/91a5d7d4-a0ac-4c48-856e-498db44126ab?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Here's just a sliver of the woke garbage you can find there:
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/d6e3a8d9-bbd5-4f6d-8026-f5fe1b7eef79?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Now those are just three programs I thought of this morning. Three places we could cut immediately and save nearly $100 million. There are many more like this.
But the governor refuses. His administration won't even discuss it.
Here's what kills me about this whole thing. We're not broke. Idaho's sitting on rainy day funds around $880 million right now. Buckets of money stashed away. Reserves that would make most states jealous (and we're not in a recession. Idaho's economy is strong. Revenue is still growing year over year).
So what crisis are we talking about exactly?
**We don 't have a revenue problem. We have a spending problem. **
If we've got $880 million sitting in reserves, and we're refusing to cut a single education program, and the governor's staff is recommending we ignore Trump's tax cuts? Then this isn't a "budget crisis" \- it's a priorities problem.
The state government wants to keep growing. Keep spending. Keep every program running at full throttle. And they want Idaho families to keep footing the bill.
But I'd rather stabilize Idaho families than the Idaho government.
Education is the second biggest spending blob in Idaho's budget. It keeps growing every year, more money, more programs, and more administration. But we're not getting results that justify the cost.
Idaho Launch doesn't make college affordable. It makes taxpayers fund other people's degrees. The CTE program? Maybe it helps some kids but we're choosing government programs over the people who fund them. Idaho Public Television? $4 million we're spending through the education budget.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/cb058709-ad1b-4b73-9e54-9763a37829c9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
So Governor Little can keep doing his Trump cosplay thing in DC...
He can smile at the cameras and pretend he's on board with tax cuts and fiscal conservatism. But back home, _**his administration is telling our legislature to reject the tax policy in the bill he 's supposedly supporting.**_ And he refuses to cut a single dollar from education spending while calling it a budget crisis.
You can't claim you're with Trump while your staff kills his policies. You can't claim there's a budget crisis while refusing to cut spending. You can't fund public television, Idaho Launch, Medicaid Expansion, and all kinds of other pet projects and pretend you're serious about fiscal responsibility.
The math doesn't work. The story doesn't hold together. And the people paying attention are getting tired of the performance.
So what's it going to be? Are we going to actually cut spending and give money back to families? Or are we going to keep pretending we support Trump's agenda while doing the exact opposite in Idaho?
Because from where I'm sitting, watching the governor in DC while his staff undermines him at home, it looks like we've already made that choice.
