In a hard-to-watch moment for Democrats, rap legend Nicki Minaj **[took the mic from President Donald Trump](https://substack.com/redirect/fb70405c-95a2-4a51-9caa-4def742df5e4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** and said something that shattered the left's entire political narrative.
"I am probably the President's number one fan,... the hate does not effect me at all, it actually motivates me to support him more!" **[Minaj said unapologetically.](https://substack.com/redirect/fb70405c-95a2-4a51-9caa-4def742df5e4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** "God is protecting him!"
## [Watch the powerful MAGA moment here:](https://substack.com/redirect/fb70405c-95a2-4a51-9caa-4def742df5e4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
[](https://substack.com/redirect/fb70405c-95a2-4a51-9caa-4def742df5e4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
[Click To Watch Video](https://substack.com/redirect/fb70405c-95a2-4a51-9caa-4def742df5e4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* * *
# **Tom Homan vows to stay in Minnesota "until the problem is gone"**
White House border czar Tom Homan vowed Thursday **[to remain in Minnesota leading ICE operations there"until the problem is gone"](https://substack.com/redirect/c6203222-995a-4733-88e4-8c4515b0aee8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** during his first news conference since President Donald Trump sent him to the Twin Cities earlier this week, saying the administration is working on a "drawdown plan" to decrease the presence of federal agents in the state.
## Watch:
[](https://substack.com/redirect/fdd19db5-8875-44ca-a8f7-16d83fcc0b6a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* **Minnesota AG agrees to notify ICE of violent illegal alien releases:** Homan said he had a "very productive" meeting with Minnesota Attorney General Keith Ellison on Wednesday, with Ellison agreeing to notify ICE when local jails were releasing violent illegal aliens--a major request from federal law enforcement--explaining "One ICE agent can arrest one bad guy when he's behind the safety and security of a jail" rather than sending "a whole team out" to arrest someone "on his turf where he has access to who knows what weapons."
* **Deployment follows deaths of two U.S. citizens during clashes:** Trump deployed Homan to Minnesota after heated clashes between anti-ICE agitators and federal agents across the Twin Cities resulted in the deaths of two U.S. citizens, Renee Nicole Good and Alex Pretti, at the hands of law enforcement, with the Trump administration accusing Minnesota leaders including Ellison, Gov. Tim Walz, and Minneapolis Mayor Jacob Frey of encouraging harassment of federal law enforcement.

* * *
## _Must Watch:_
# **Marco Rubio goes FULL MAGA when aggressive Democrat makes HUGE MISTAKE!**
Secretary of State Marco Rubio waged WAR on Senate Democrats, defending President Donald Trump's America First foreign policy tooth and nail against half-baked attacks.
## [Watch him take down Democrat Sen. Tammy Duckworth:](https://substack.com/redirect/2a18e312-1417-4a7e-94dc-3004e0080a99?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
[](https://substack.com/redirect/2a18e312-1417-4a7e-94dc-3004e0080a99?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
[Click To Watch Video](https://substack.com/redirect/2a18e312-1417-4a7e-94dc-3004e0080a99?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* * *
# **Greg Bovino tells agents "I've got your back" after Minneapolis removal**
Border Patrol chief Greg Bovino told his men "I've got your back, now and always" in **[his first public statement since being removed](https://substack.com/redirect/91e43031-cd60-404c-a731-39acfdbfba3c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** from leading immigration sweeps in Minneapolis, saying "I love you, I support you, and I salute you" while standing in front of Mount Rushmore in a video posted late Wednesday by conservative journalist Nick Sortor.
## Watch:
[](https://substack.com/redirect/835d4ff7-99d0-48d6-bfde-d3e6fc3322a3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* **Chief sidelined after fatal shooting of ICU nurse Alex Pretti:** The 55-year-old had been ordered out of the Twin Cities earlier this week, along with some of his men, following the January 24 killing of ICU nurse Alex Pretti in a struggle with federal enforcement officials, after Bovino initially claimed Pretti had been brandishing a gun when shot--a claim disputed by the media after footage showed Pretti had been disarmed of his Sig Sauer P320 9mm pistol when the gunfire began.
* **Bovino remains defiant, praises "Mean Green Machine":** Bovino appeared defiant in Tuesday's video, telling rank-and-file agents "I'm very proud of what you, the Mean Green Machine, are doing in Minneapolis right now, just like you've done it across the United States over these past tough nine months."

* * *
# **" Breaking Bad" actor admits willingness to see millions die for "revolution"**
"Breaking Bad" actor Giancarlo Esposito told Variety **["This is time for a revolution"](https://substack.com/redirect/1ef3d2de-a590-4867-9ba9-19e7508072aa?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** and said "If the whole world showed up...in Washington, they'd kill 500 or 50 million or however [many], but the rest of us would survive with a new [world]."

[](https://substack.com/redirect/09e49968-5084-46a5-83ba-14b542b48d2d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

[1]Justice Democrats

BREAKING, Peter:

Today, Justice Democrats is proud to announce our TENTH endorsement of the
2026 election cycle: Mai Vang in California’s 7th congressional district!

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260129-mv.sy_KIj&refcode=em20260129-37412&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1002&akid=37412%2E1203867%2EHPrKvA ]Justice Democrats 2026 Endorsed Mai Vang for U.S. Congress CA-07

Mai is a Sacramento City Councilmember and a proven progressive champion
who’s running to put working families above corporate interests, to
deliver housing you can afford and healthcare you can count on, and keep
communities safe from ICE’s terror.

She’s taking on a corporate-backed incumbent who’s been in power for 20
years — it’s time for a change in leadership. [ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260129-mv.sy_KIj&refcode=em20260129-37412&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1003&akid=37412%2E1203867%2EHPrKvA ]Help Mai win by making a
grassroots donation directly to her campaign now!

Mai is the daughter of Hmong refugees who fled war in Laos to settle in
Sacramento, where Mai was born and raised as the eldest of 16 children.
She’s a proud product of local public schools and was the first in her
family to attend college.

Before she was elected to office, Mai worked as a community organizer to
improve health and educational outcomes for children and families in south
Sacramento. Under the first Trump administration, she championed and
passed the first-ever Safe Haven Resolution, ensuring that California
schools remained a place of safety and protection for all students and
families, regardless of immigration status.

In 2020, Mai was elected to represent Sacramento’s Eighth City Council
District. Under her leadership:

* The city established the first-ever Sacramento Children’s Fund,
dedicating $10 million annually to support children and youth impacted
by poverty, violence, and trauma.
* She led one of the most linguistically diverse community-run
vaccination clinics in the nation during the COVID-19 pandemic.
* She created and co-led the Food Justice Task Force to secure $1.5
million to address food insecurity in her community.
* She secured the city's purchase of 102 acres of undeveloped land in
South Sacramento for the future development of affordable housing,
civic amenities, and an economic engine to drive revenue in the
district.

Incumbent Rep. Matsui was first elected to Congress in 2005, after
succeeding her late husband, who held the seat since 1979. The Matsui
family has represented this district for nearly 50 years, but working
families still cannot afford housing or healthcare. They’re waking up to
realize that seniority without urgency is not enough to defend them
against the Trump administration.

While Mai is refusing corporate PAC money to remain accountable to the
people of the district, Rep. Matsui continues to cash hundreds of
thousands of checks from corporate PACs.

Mai has also been an outspoken critic of Israel’s genocide in Gaza,
drafting and pushing through a ceasefire resolution as a City
Councilmember, while her opponent has been backed and bought by AIPAC.
During her time in Washington, Matsui has voted to send billions of
dollars to ICE, tripling its budget since entering Congress.

Mai isn't hiding behind corporate donors and polite statements—she's
fighting for her community. That's the kind of leadership that can help
rebuild a Democratic Party that actually fights for working people in the
face of Trump’s fascism.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260129-mv.sy_KIj&refcode=em20260129-37412&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1004&akid=37412%2E1203867%2EHPrKvA ]Let’s build the resources Mai needs to take on a career politician
backed by corporate PACs — and WIN! Rush $5 or more: 100%
of your contribution will go toward Mai’s campaign to win this Democratic
primary in June.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260129-mv.sy_KIj&refcode=em20260129-37412&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1023&akid=37412%2E1203867%2EHPrKvA ]Contribute $5

In solidarity,

Alexandra Rojas
Executive Director

Under her leadership: The city established the first-ever Sacramento Children’s Fund, dedicating $10 million annually to support children and youth impacted by poverty, violence, and trauma. She led one of the most linguistically diverse community-run vaccination clinics in the nation during the COVID-19 pandemic. She created and co-led the Food Justice Task Force to secure $1.5 million to address food insecurity in her community. She secured the city's purchase of 102 acres of undeveloped land in South Sacramento for the future development of affordable housing, civic amenities, and an economic engine to drive revenue in the district. Incumbent Rep. Matsui was first elected to Congress in 2005, after succeeding her late husband, who held the seat since 1979. The Matsui family has represented this district for nearly 50 years, but working families still cannot afford housing or healthcare. They’re waking up to realize that seniority without urgency is not enough to defend them against the Trump administration. While Mai is refusing corporate PAC money to remain accountable to the people of the district, Rep. Matsui continues to cash hundreds of thousands of checks from corporate PACs. Mai has also been an outspoken critic of Israel’s genocide in Gaza, drafting and pushing through a ceasefire resolution as a City Councilmember, while her opponent has been backed and bought by AIPAC. During her time in Washington, Matsui has voted to send billions of dollars to ICE, tripling its budget since entering Congress. Mai isn't hiding behind corporate donors and polite statements—she's fighting for her community. That's the kind of leadership that can help rebuild a Democratic Party that actually fights for working people in the face of Trump’s fascism. The reality, though, is that some people (political insiders, mostly) look at the report and decide whether you’re “serious” before they ever look at your plan. **So here’s what our report says right now: we have real momentum.** When we started this race, I wasn’t the institutional pick. I’m not a career politician backed by powerful people with deep pockets and insider connections. We’re building this campaign the hard way, the authentic way, one person at a time. And it’s working. **2025 Fundraising Totals:** ********So we’re in the lead with our fundraising, and that’s a strong start. But here is the number that matters more to me: **2025 Individual Donors:****
****** More than twice as many people have chosen to be part of this campaign. And I feel it. Some gifts are $100, some are $10, some are $1. The $1 donations get me every time because it’s someone saying, “I’m in,” even if it’s a stretch. Heck, there have been times in my life when adding 60 cents worth of guacamole to my burrito felt too spendy. Hello friend,
My name is Gloria Giffords. I’m Gabby Giffords’s mom. This month marked fifteen years since my daughter was shot. I still remember that day vividly.
It was the morning of January 8, 2011. I was at the UPS store when I received a phone call from my son-in-law, Mark Kelly, with the details he knew at the time. I said the first words that came to my mind:
**“Someone shot my baby.”**
Fifteen years have passed, but the memories are still painful to this day. But to know Gabby Giffords is to know one thing:_Don’t ever — not for one moment — underestimate her._
I stand in awe of my daughter. Even when she was little, if she thought she could do something, she would put her mind to it until it was done.
It’s been a long road to recovery, but she keeps fighting — not only for herself, but for families all across our country. She inspires me every day, and I know I’m not alone.
It’s now been fifteen years since that awful day in January 2011. I know that, more than everything, Gabby wants to make the world safer from gun violence — to prevent tragedies like hers from happening to others.
**So I want to humbly ask:** [**Will you please consider donating to GIFFORDS PAC today? name: PoliticsPA
subject: Open primaries, independent voters in PA
body:
Philadelphia's PA Rep. Jared Solomon talks open primaries and shares his thoughts on district mapping | | | |
---
| | | [ ](https://onpattison.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=5b6c18f347&e=b7b3eddce2)
---
| **Big Names Make News**
---
| “Many veterans decide to register as unaffiliated, or independent. Imagine you’re a veteran. You’ve served your country down range. You get honorably discharged. And then, you want to participate in our democracy. We here in Pennsylvania say, ‘Nope. We value your service, but not enough that you can actually vote in our primary system.” \- PA Rep. Jared Solomon (202 District, Philadelphia County) [[Watch](https://onpattison.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=043c37ed11&e=b7b3eddce2)]

“Parties here in Pennsylvania, in a closed primary system, have the power to draw the lines in districts throughout the Commonwealth and control who votes. This is another reform we need, which is a citizen-led commission to re-draw our lines.” - PA Rep. Jared Solomon (202 District, Philadelphia County) [[Watch](https://onpattison.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=37c673c7ac&e=b7b3eddce2)]
---

---
| **Should independents vote in PA primaries?**
---
| It was 2024 that we last sat down with PA Representative Jared Solomon of the 202nd district, but the topic of open primaries remains an issue in the Commonwealth. From an opportunity to participate in our nation's democracy, to having fair and rational district maps, it seems some hot-button issues don't change with time.

Hear what thoughts this Philadelphia-based representative had at the time, and decide for yourself what may still be open for debate in 2026. Should all voters be permitted to participate in primary elections? Are the Commonwealth's maps unfair?
---

|
---
| **Maps You Need to See**
---
| Rep. Jared Solomon (202nd District) explained what he thinks about the Commonwealth's mapping in this 2024 interview. The maps for Pennsylvania have not changed since 2022. The Atlantic: Donald Trump’s Plan to Subvert the Midterms Is Already Under Way [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=012926_1&amount=25]
Team, that headline from The Atlantic says it all.
Donald Trump already promised as part of his 2024 campaign that “we’ll have it fixed so good, you’re not gonna have to vote .” Watching his actions after he lost in 2020 -- lies, denial, rallies, all leading to January 6th -- it's not hard to imagine what he's got in mind for November.
Our states run our elections. But that doesn't mean that MAGA-aligned politicians won't follow his illegal orders to interfere. It doesn't stop him from using ICE agents to intimidate at the polls or threaten eligible voters. And it doesn't stop his Department of Justice from trying to interfere through the courts, especially when more than half of the suppressive lawsuits brought to court this year were brought by the very federal department that's supposed to protect our rights.
None of that takes into account the highly partisan efforts for mid-decade redistricting as well. It's clear that the threats to the next election aren't going to stop. That's where we come in.

,
Huge news for our campaign.
**A Virginia state court just blocked Democrats’ attempt** to force through a last-minute redistricting scheme designed to shut candidates like me out of the race before voters ever had a say.
For months, Democrats tried to redraw Virginia’s congressional map behind closed doors, hoping to clear the field and silence conservatives. That effort has now been stopped.

# Kevin Standing Strong on Local Control
---
| | Dear Friend and Patriot,
I hope this email finds you and your family well. I'm energized by the growing momentum across Michigan as we head toward the nomination and beyond. Grassroots Republicans like you are responding to a proven fighter who puts Michigan families first.
On Tuesday, I stood before the Chesterfield Township Board of Trustees with a packed room of concerned residents to strongly support a resolution strengthening local zoning rules for massive data centers that do not benefit Michigan families. [You can watch the brief video by clicking on the image below](https://kevinformi.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=39782b0ca6b504d2faad7a196&id=b58c378d16&e=4b10910eed):
[](https://kevinformi.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=39782b0ca6b504d2faad7a196&id=496d681ebd&e=4b10910eed)
With my family and friends in this area of Macomb County, I spoke about the real risks these facilities pose – from national security concerns near Selfridge Air National Guard Base to skyrocketing utility costs for Michigan families due to special power deals favoring Big Tech.
**Local control is a core principle worth protecting**. Communities should be able to set strong zoning standards and defend residents from corporate overreach – without state preemption. As your next Attorney General, I'll demand full transparency at the Michigan Public Service Commission, scrutinize these contracts, and fiercely defend ratepayers.
**But some have suggested that holding sanctuary cities accountable risks infringing on that same principle of local control.** Anyone who makes that argument is simply wrong for Michigan**** communities and families. [The Detroit News makes this distinction crystal clear and you can read it by clicking here](https://kevinformi.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=39782b0ca6b504d2faad7a196&id=ac110866ab&e=4b10910eed).
**True local control stops where public safety begins.** Sanctuary policies aren't legitimate local decisions — they're deliberate obstructions of federal law that shield dangerous illegal aliens and endanger our families.
We see the opposite danger with sanctuary policies that obstruct federal law enforcement and create foreseeable harm to our communities. These are affirmative acts that prioritize radical ideology over the rule of law and public safety.
Attorneys with civil and constitutional experience – like me – know the innovative tools available to solve this crisis. **As Michigan’s next Attorney General, we'll audit sanctuary cities, hold them accountable, partner with ICE and federal authorities, and prioritize Michigan families above all**. No excuses.
---
| | **Let’s Keep Winning for Michigan Families!**
Thank you for standing with me as we fight to restore security, defend freedom, and rebuild trust in Michigan. Together, we'll make Michigan safe, affordable, normal, and red again. I'm honored to earn your support – let's secure this nomination and win big.
Very truly yours,Kevin Kijewski
Republican Candidate for Michigan Attorney General

subject: I’m running for governor of the state of Minnesota
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Kaine for Virginia
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-cgp-26-klobuchar?amount=50 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-cgp-26-klobuchar?amount=50]
Derek --
I wanted you to be one of the first to hear the news: I’m running for governor of the state of Minnesota. This is a home-grown campaign, born in a moment like no other.
I’m going to tell you why in a moment. But first: Will you help us get off to a strong start by splitting a donation between Tim Kaine and my campaign? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-cgp-26-klobuchar?amount=50]
I’m not going to sugar coat it -- Minnesota has been through a lot.
The killings of two innocent Minnesotans. Three thousand ICE agents on our streets and in our towns, sent by an administration that relishes division. Minnesotans stood up. Our state has been the center of America’s heartbreak. But we have also been the center of America's courage and America's hope. In moments of enormous difficulty, we find strength in our Minnesota values of hard work, freedom, and simple decency and good will.
These moments call for grit and resilience. I’ve learned resilience from the people of Minnesota. They have stood up, they have marched, and they have brought food to their neighbors. Through it all we do not give up.
And grit? I learned that from my family. I’m the daughter of a newspaperman and a proud union member teacher. My grandpa worked 1500 feet underground in the mines on the Iron Range, and he saved his money in a coffee can in the basement to send my dad to college. I wouldn’t be where I am today without them.
These times call for leaders who can stand up and not be rubber stamps of this administration. But who are also willing to find common ground and fix things in our state.
I led our state’s biggest prosecutors’ office for eight years and then you gave me the honor of serving as your United States Senator. I was ranked number one in the Senate for bipartisan bills and number three out of one hundred for getting bills passed into law.
I will do my job without fear or favor. I’ve never shied away from taking on the powerful. That’s what I did as prosecutor. That’s what I did as senator. And that’s what I will do as your governor.
I believe we must stand up for what’s right. And fix what’s wrong. I am running for every Minnesotan who wants to buy their first home, for every parent who wants a better world for their kids, for everyone who wants more affordable healthcare. I am running for every Minnesotan who wants to protect our democracy and get ICE and its abusive tactics out of the state we love.
And I'm running for every student, farmer, dreamer and builder.
But to accomplish everything we’re setting out to do, I need your support.
This campaign is for people who believe in something bigger than ourselves. For people who know that things have got to change.
So please: Will you support my campaign for governor with a donation today? Your contribution will be split with Tim Kaine. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-cgp-26-klobuchar?amount=50]
If you’ve saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your split donation to Amy Klobuchar and Tim Kaine will go through immediately:
DONATE $25 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-cgp-26-klobuchar?express_lane=true&amount=25]
DONATE $50 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-cgp-26-klobuchar?express_lane=true&amount=50]
DONATE $100 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-cgp-26-klobuchar?express_lane=true&amount=100]
OTHER [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-cgp-26-klobuchar?amount=50]
I like my job in the Senate. But I love our state more than any job. I love the people of Minnesota. And Minnesota, I want to be a transformative governor.
Now is our moment to renew our commitment to the common good. I’m asking you to look up to the North Star and to see that there is a better future before us.
To pursue good, we must believe that good will prevail. I know I do -- and that’s why I’m asking you to join us.
Amy

**I’m running for governor as a proud Democrat because Georgia deserves leadership that puts people over extremism.**

The ICE raids we are seeing across the country are inhumane and un-American. As governor, I’ll ensure our state’s assets are _never_ used to support an immigration policy based on intimidation and fear. subject: The book Charlie left behind
body:
Charlie Kirk lived fast. And he lived loud.

| | | [](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2z2ee4ok1i7t5b04ulrp09mfe0i1b9k8p7c22khjg_rp22sh2s8i6eor4sth68pj4c5h2bs)
---
| | Friend,
---
| | Charlie Kirk built a movement for truth -- but his final message pointed to something eternal.

It wasn't about politics... or elections... or even about the culture war.

His final book was deeply personal, and unlike anything Charlie had written before...

**It was about the Sabbath. **

About sacred rest. Reconnecting with God.
---
[](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zknckjqnhr80q8v6uble6vrb2qib6k2dauisigd0_rp22sh2s8i6eor4sth68pj4c5h2bs)
---
**[And when you make a gift of any amount to Turning Point USA today, we'll send you a copy of Charlie's final book -- as our thank you for carrying his legacy forward.](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2z60kvrp6j4pag8db40rnedgmlip37j7iifqsgvh0_rp22sh2s8i6eor4sth68pj4c5h2bs)**
---
[ **Support Turning Point USA**
**& Receive Charlie's Final Book**](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2ztbpu5sanqol6jaq63id9hheemdm9593bbjovbrg_rp22sh2s8i6eor4sth68pj4c5h2bs)
---
Charlie wrote this book because he knew what America was missing... and what he nearly lost himself.

He found that in a world addicted to busyness, noise, and scrolling...

_**The most radical act of resistance is to STOP. **_

To rest. To reflect. To return to God.

This book is his blueprint for how we do that -- as individuals, as families, and as a nation.

🔥 You'll discover how Charlie learned to honor the Sabbath in a culture that never stops
🔥 How setting aside just one day a week gave him clarity, peace, and strength
🔥 Why he believed this message could spark a spiritual revival across America

I know he would've wanted you to have this book.

**When you give today to Turning Point USA, you 're not just supporting the movement Charlie built -- you're helping pass on the message he felt most urgently in his final months. **

**[And we'll ship you a copy of Charlie's final book straight to your door.](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zlaoji57387g9t5m8ld1h28669e9c19a2cp6kg00_rp22sh2s8i6eor4sth68pj4c5h2bs)**

[ **Support Turning Point USA**
**& Receive Charlie's Final Book**](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zrrnsrk0rbqcf8rdag05aaa20n4r53ebnub6482g_rp22sh2s8i6eor4sth68pj4c5h2bs)
---
Friend, thank you, in advance, for helping reach the next generation with truth, faith, and moral courage -- _the very things Charlie gave his life for. _

And as you do, may the message of this book lead you -- just as it led Charlie -- to a deeper trust in God, a stronger love for your family, and a renewed peace in your own soul.
---
**For Charlie, **

**Justin Streiff **
Chief Operating Officer
Turning Point USA

name: Amy Klobuchar
subject: I'm running for governor of the state of Minnesota
body:
To accomplish everything we're setting out to do, we need your support.
---
| [](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dnc-mn-split?amount=20&refcode=em_20260129_5942_fr&refcode2=5942_22930333_S9RlNi&akid=5942%2E22930333%2ES9RlNi)
---
Derek —
I wanted you to be one of the first to hear the news: I’m running for governor of the state of Minnesota. **This is a home-grown campaign, born in a moment like no other.**
[**I’m going to tell you why in a moment. But first: Will you help elect Democrats up and down the ballot in Minnesota and beyond by splitting a donation between the DNC and the Minnesota Democratic–Farmer–Labor Party?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dnc-mn-split?amount=20&refcode=em_20260129_5942_fr&refcode2=5942_22930333_S9RlNi&akid=5942%2E22930333%2ES9RlNi)
I’m not going to sugarcoat it — Minnesota has been through a lot.
The killings of two innocent Minnesotans. Three thousand ICE agents on our streets and in our towns, sent by an administration that relishes division. Minnesotans stood up. Our state has been the center of America’s heartbreak. But we have also been the center of America’s courage and America’s hope. In moments of enormous difficulty, we find strength in our Minnesota values of hard work, freedom, and simple decency and goodwill.
**These moments call for grit and resilience.** I’ve learned resilience from the people of Minnesota. They have stood up, they have marched, and they have brought food to their neighbors. Through it all we do not give up.
And grit? I learned that from my family. I’m the daughter of a newspaperman and a proud union member teacher. My grandpa worked 1500 feet underground in the mines on the Iron Range, and he saved his money in a coffee can in the basement to send my dad to college. I wouldn’t be where I am today without them.
**These times call for leaders who can stand up and not be rubber stamps of this administration.** But who are also willing to find common ground and fix things in our states.
I led my state’s biggest prosecutors’ office for eight years and then Minnesotans gave me the honor of serving as their United States Senator. I was ranked number one in the Senate for bipartisan bills and number three out of one hundred for getting bills passed into law.
**I will do my job without fear or favor. I’ve never shied away from taking on the powerful. That’s what I did as a prosecutor. That’s what I did as a senator. And that’s what I will do as governor.**
I believe we must stand up for what’s right. And fix what’s wrong. I am running for every Minnesotan who wants to buy their first home, for every parent who wants a better world for their kids, for everyone who wants more affordable health care. I am running for every Minnesotan who wants to protect our democracy and get ICE and its abusive tactics out of the state we love.
And I’m running for every student, farmer, dreamer and builder.
_But to accomplish everything we’re setting out to do, we need your support._
**This campaign is for people who believe in something bigger than ourselves. For people who know that things have got to change.**
[**So please: Will you support the Minnesota Democratic–Farmer–Labor Party with a donation today? Your contribution will be split with the DNC.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dnc-mn-split?amount=20&refcode=em_20260129_5942_fr&refcode2=5942_22930333_S9RlNi&akid=5942%2E22930333%2ES9RlNi)
**I like my job in the Senate. But I love my state more than any job.** I love the people of Minnesota. And I want to be a transformative governor.
Now is our moment to renew our commitment to the common good. I’m asking you to look up to the North Star and to see that there is a better future before us.
To pursue good, we must believe that good will prevail. I know I do — and that’s why I’m asking you to join us.
Amy

_If you gave recently via check or mail, our system may not have yet processed your gift. We are appreciative and thank you greatly for your support._

clean_body: @media only screen and (min-width: 520px) { .u-row { width: 500px !important; } .u-row .u-col { vertical-align: top; } .u-row .u-col-100 { width: 500px !important; } } @media only screen and (max-width: 520px) { .u-row-container { max-width: 100% !important; padding-left: 0px !important; padding-right: 0px !important; } .u-row { width: 100% !important; } .u-row .u-col { display: block !important; width: 100% !important; min-width: 320px !important; max-width: 100% !important; } .u-row .u-col > div { margin: 0 auto; } } body{margin:0;padding:0}table,td,tr{border-collapse:collapse;vertical-align:top}p{margin:0}.ie-container table,.mso-container table{table-layout:fixed}*{line-height:inherit}a[x-apple-data-detectors=true]{color:inherit!important;text-decoration:none!important} table, td { color: #000000; } #u_body a { color: #0000ee; text-decoration: underline; } Dear Peter, Apologies for the delayed outreach. I have no power, water, or internet, and it took me several days to leave my house. Here’s an update on the ongoing winter storm and its impact on our community in Davidson County. First and foremost, restoring power remains the top priority. Prolonged extreme cold has placed significant strain on our electric and water systems, and outages are continuing in parts of Nashville. Utility crews are working around the clock, and the State has taken steps to expedite restoration by authorizing TDOT to clear non-state roads so line workers can access damaged areas more quickly. Current conditions in Davidson County Extremely cold temperatures and icy, refreezing road conditions continue. Power outages are ongoing in some neighborhoods. Some water systems are experiencing impacts; please follow guidance from your local water provider. Cellular service may be limited in areas due to power loss, but 911 remains available for life-threatening emergencies. Welfare checks Davidson County has its own process for welfare checks.If you are concerned about someone’s safety, please submit a request through Metro Nashville’s official online hub. Do not use the statewide hotline for Davidson County residents. Warming centers Warming centers remain open across Nashville, with some transitioning into overnight shelters. Nashville residents needing transportation to a warming station can call 615-401-1712. Callers should share their location, needs and whether pets are included.Hours and availability vary, so please check Metro Nashville’s official shelter information or contact the local Emergency Management Agency for assistance. Safety reminders Avoid driving if at all possible. Ice and refreezing conditions make roads extremely hazardous. Stay clear of downed power lines and assume all lines are energized. Limit time outdoors to avoid hypothermia and frostbite. Use extreme caution when heating your home: Never use generators, grills, or propane heaters indoors.Keep generators at least 20 feet from your home and never connect them directly to your electrical system. Use space heaters safely and never leave them unattended. If you lose power, discard perishable food that has been above 40°F for more than two hours. If you need help If you or someone you know needs assistance with storm-related cleanup, Crisis Cleanup is available at 844-965-1386. Services are free, but availability may be limited. Check on elderly neighbors, people with disabilities, and anyone relying on medical equipment. The State remains under a declared State of Emergency, and I am in regular communication with local and state officials as response and recovery continue. I will continue to share updates as conditions change. I spent yesterday on the phone with the National Guard, TEMA, TDOT, and the Office of Emergency Management specifically to push for additional resources in our hardest-hit areas. As a result of those conversations, 50 National Guard troops and two skid steers are being deployed to South and West Nashville to assist with debris removal, which is a critical step in clearing access so NES lineworkers can restore power more quickly and safely. I share your concern about the pace of restoration and the strain on NES crews. While only trained lineworkers can perform electrical repairs, clearing trees and debris is often the bottleneck, and this additional state support will make an immediate difference there. I am also pressing for continued coordination between the city, state agencies, and NES to ensure resources are focused where outages have persisted the longest. I know this does not make the current situation any easier, but please know that I am actively advocating for you and your neighbors and will continue pushing until power is restored and conditions stabilize. Please stay safe, conserve energy where possible, and rely on official local sources for accurate information. If my office can help connect you to resources, don’t hesitate to reach out. My cell is 615.438.6338. Stay safe out there, Senator Heidi Campbell425 Rep. John Lewis Way N.Suite 770 Cordell Hull Bldg.Nashville, TN 37243Phone: (615) 741-6679Fax: (615) 253-0313 Senator Heidi Campbell is a Tennessee State Senator, representing District 20. She is championing change for Tennessee and won't rest until we see gun safety reform, corporate accountability, and a safe and prosperous community where everyone can thrive. I’m not going to sugar coat it – Minnesota has been through a lot.

The killings of two innocent Minnesotans. Three thousand ICE agents on our streets and in our towns, sent by an administration that relishes division. Minnesotans stood up. Our state has been the center of America’s heartbreak. But we have also been the center of America's courage and America's hope. In moments of enormous difficulty, we find strength in our Minnesota values of hard work, freedom, and simple decency and good will.

[**These moments call for grit and resilience.**](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/72879?t=12&akid=23872%2E4449941%2EwFE6eU) I’ve learned resilience from the people of Minnesota. They have stood up, they have marched, and they have brought food to their neighbors. Through it all we do not give up.

And grit? I learned that from my family. I’m the daughter of a newspaperman and a proud union member teacher. My grandpa worked 1500 feet underground in the mines on the Iron Range, and he saved his money in a coffee can in the basement to send my dad to college. I wouldn’t be where I am today without them.

[**These times call for leaders who can stand up and not be rubber stamps of this administration.**](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/72879?t=13&akid=23872%2E4449941%2EwFE6eU) But who are also willing to find common ground and fix things in our state. I led our state’s biggest prosecutors’ office for eight years and then you gave me the honor of serving as your United States Senator. I was ranked number one in the Senate for bipartisan bills and number three out of one hundred for getting bills passed into law.

[**I will do my job without fear or favor. I’ve never shied away from taking on the powerful. That’s what I did as prosecutor. That’s what I did as senator. And that’s what I will do as your governor.**](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/72879?t=14&akid=23872%2E4449941%2EwFE6eU)

I believe we must stand up for what’s right. And fix what’s wrong. I am running for every Minnesotan who wants to buy their first home, for every parent who wants a better world for their kids, for everyone who wants more affordable healthcare. I am running for every Minnesotan who wants to protect our democracy and get ICE and its abusive tactics out of the state we love.

And I'm running for every student, farmer, dreamer and builder.

_But to accomplish everything we’re setting out to do, I need your support._

[**This campaign is for people who believe in something bigger than ourselves. For people who know that things have got to change.**](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/72879?t=15&akid=23872%2E4449941%2EwFE6eU)

[**So please: Will you support my campaign for governor with a donation today? Your contribution will be split with Fight For Reform.**](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/72879?t=16&akid=23872%2E4449941%2EwFE6eU)

subject: The message Charlie carried into eternity
body:
[Mark as Spam](https://trk.americanmediawatchdog.com/?xul=6zs1j7t5dhe4avz97uxx7mw1u7lxta8ejloo99pqged0bfalwj335262wn7mssem5jxi4hf10bc2rjhi3cmaw1ahuh5en9u8qbfbe8v1sjnnqj7cxh&__stmp=t9mwcr&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh) | [Unsubscribe](https://trk.americanmediawatchdog.com/?xul=6zs1j7t5dhe4avz97uxx7mw1u7lxta8ejloo99pqged0bfalwj335262wn7mssem5jxi4hf10bc2rjhi3cmaw1ahuh5en9u8qbfbe8v1sjnnqj7cxh&__stmp=t9mwcr&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh)
Please read the message below from our sponsor.
* * *
| | | [](https://trk.americanmediawatchdog.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t9mwcr&__onlt=h)
---
| | Friend,
---
| | Charlie would have wanted you to have this.

Before his September 10th assassination, Charlie had just put the finishing touches on a very important book. His final book.

The topic is one that Charlie found to be crucial for every human to understand and practice.

This isn’t a book about public policy or political discourse, nor is it simply about passing on values of patriotism to young Americans.

**Instead, this book is about something far deeper and more personal — the importance of honoring the Sabbath and resting in God’s grace.**

Despite his hectic schedule and full life, Charlie was committed to setting aside an entire day each week to rest, to pray, and to give undivided attention to God, Erika, and his children.

By honoring the Sabbath, Charlie lived out a powerful message: _**“God, You are enough. And because You are enough, I need not carry the weight of a world that was never mine to hold.”**_

His book, _**Stop, in the Name of God**_ is the fruit of that conviction.
---
[](https://trk.americanmediawatchdog.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t9mwcr&__onlt=h)
---
When you read it, you will hear Charlie’s voice inviting you to reclaim something our fast-paced culture has essentially erased: a time for rest, a time devoted to God, and time with family.

Charlie’s hope was for each of us to rediscover the Sabbath as he did: not as a burden to bear, but as a gift to receive...

A sacred routine meant to draw us nearer to God, to steady our hearts with His peace, and renew our strength for the battles to which He calls us.

I believe you will find this book inspiring.

Charlie wanted everyone to have this book because its message meant so much in his own life.

name: Amy Klobuchar
subject: I want to be a transformative governor for the state of Minnesota.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Minnesotans for Klobuchar
body:
To accomplish everything we’re setting out to do, I need your support.
| Peter -- I wanted you to be one of the first to hear the news: I’m running for governor of the state of Minnesota. **This is a home-grown campaign, born in a moment like no other.** **[I’m going to tell you why in a moment. But first: Will you help us get off to a strong start by splitting a donation between Roy Cooper and my campaign?](https://act.roycooper.com/go/5201?t=2&akid=439%2E124072%2E59YhcO)** I’m not going to sugar coat it -- Minnesota has been through a lot. The killings of two innocent Minnesotans. Three thousand ICE agents on our streets and in our towns, sent by an administration that relishes division. Minnesotans stood up. Our state has been the center of America’s heartbreak. But we have also been the center of America's courage and America's hope. In moments of enormous difficulty, we find strength in our Minnesota values of hard work, freedom, and simple decency and good will. **These moments call for grit and resilience.** I’ve learned resilience from the people of Minnesota. They have stood up, they have marched, and they have brought food to their neighbors. Through it all we do not give up. And grit? I learned that from my family. I’m the daughter of a newspaperman and a proud union member teacher. My grandpa worked 1500 feet underground in the mines on the Iron Range, and he saved his money in a coffee can in the basement to send my dad to college. I wouldn’t be where I am today without them. **These times call for leaders who can stand up and not be rubber stamps of this administration.** But who are also willing to find common ground and fix things in our state. I led our state’s biggest prosecutors’ office for eight years and then you gave me the honor of serving as your United States Senator. I was ranked number one in the Senate for bipartisan bills and number three out of one hundred for getting bills passed into law. **I will do my job without fear or favor. I’ve never shied away from taking on the powerful. That’s what I did as prosecutor. That’s what I did as senator. And that’s what I will do as your governor.** I believe we must stand up for what’s right. And fix what’s wrong. I am running for every Minnesotan who wants to buy their first home, for every parent who wants a better world for their kids, for everyone who wants more affordable healthcare. I am running for every Minnesotan who wants to protect our democracy and get ICE and its abusive tactics out of the state we love. And I'm running for every student, farmer, dreamer and builder. _But to accomplish everything we’re setting out to do, I need your support._ **This campaign is for people who believe in something bigger than ourselves. For people who know that things have got to change.** **[So please: Will you support my campaign for governor with a donation today? Your contribution will be split with Roy Cooper.](https://act.roycooper.com/go/5201?t=3&akid=439%2E124072%2E59YhcO)** **I like my job in the Senate. But I love our state more than any job.** I love the people of Minnesota. And Minnesota, I want to be a transformative governor. Now is our moment to renew our commitment to the common good. I’m asking you to look up to the North Star and to see that there is a better future before us. To pursue good, we must believe that good will prevail. I know I do -- and that’s why I’m asking you to join us. Amy [](https://act.roycooper.com/go/5201?t=4&akid=439%2E124072%2E59YhcO)
* * *

Charlie Kirk lived fast. And he lived loud.

It wasn't about politics... or elections... or even about the culture war.

His final book was deeply personal, and unlike anything Charlie had written before...

**It was about the Sabbath. **

About sacred rest. Reconnecting with God.

Charlie wrote this book because he knew what America was missing... and what he nearly lost himself.

This book is his blueprint for how we do that -- as individuals, as families, and as a nation.

🔥 Why he believed this message could spark a spiritual revival across America

I know he would've wanted you to have this book.

name: Colin Allred
subject: I made a difficult decision to end my campaign.
body:
Peter,
I officially ended my campaign for U.S. Senate and filed to run for Congress in Texas’ 33rd Congressional District.
I didn’t come to this decision lightly – I’ve put everything I had into my Senate campaign over the last five months, traveling to every corner of the state, talking to as many Texans as I could, building on the incredible grassroots campaign we started last year.
While it was clear that many Texans were ready to support me to the end, it was also clear that the Democratic primary would end up in a bruising and costly runoff in May. And if we want to prevent another MAGA loyalist from representing our state for six more years, that’s simply a risk we can’t afford to take.
So, today I am announcing my campaign to represent the newly drawn 33rd district in Texas. If you’d still like to see me head to Washington in November, I hope you’ll consider splitting a donation between me and Real Texas to get my new campaign off to a strong start today. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rtp-2025-allred?refcode=012926_1]
If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation to Colin Allred and The Real Texas PAC will go through immediately:
DONATE $5 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rtp-2025-allred?express_lane=true&refcode=012926_1&amount=5]
DONATE $10 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rtp-2025-allred?express_lane=true&refcode=012926_1&amount=10]
DONATE $50 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rtp-2025-allred?express_lane=true&refcode=012926_1&amount=50]
DONATE $100 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rtp-2025-allred?express_lane=true&refcode=012926_1&amount=100]
DONATE $250 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rtp-2025-allred?express_lane=true&refcode=012926_1&amount=250]
Other Amount [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rtp-2025-allred?refcode=012926_1&amount=25]
District 33 was racially gerrymandered by Republicans in an effort to further rig our democracy, but it’s still the community where I grew up attending public schools and watching my mom struggle to pay for our groceries. It’s the community where Aly and I are raising our two boys. It is my home.
The threats that our democracy and our way of living are facing right now are real. It’s harder than ever for kids like me to get a shot, and for single moms like mine to afford their basic needs. But I am more confident than I have ever been that together, we can beat these threats. That’s why I am humbly asking for your help to return to Congress to fight for North Texans, our democracy, and the American Dream.
If you can, please split a donation of a few bucks between my campaign and Real Texas to help me get started. Thank you for reading, and for all of your continued support as we fight to get Texas representation we can be proud of. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rtp-2025-allred?refcode=012926_1]
Colin Allred

**BILL TO ADDRESS SCHOOL CONSTRUCTION NEEDS ADVANCES** Our schools are in desperate need of renovation and repair. Virginia voters should have the power to decide what best supports their students and schools, including whether to invest more in local public education. HB334, which has passed the House, puts that decision where it belongs: in the hands of local voters. By allowing a local referendum on a modest sales tax dedicated to school construction, HB334 gives communities another practical tool to address outdated school buildings and invest in safe, modern learning environments for our kids.
---
**BUDGET AMENDMENT FOR REDEVELOPMENT OF DOWNTOWN ROANOKE** A casino is not the answer, but our city still needs investment. I have proposed a budget amendment requesting the Commonwealth invest $600,000 to analyze the redevelopment of downtown Roanoke, including hiring engineers to look at the older structures. This would include potential projects and pathways for the Roanoke Science Museum, Center in the Square, and land improvements around the Berglund Center complex. We must be creative to ensure that these investments leave a lasting positive impact on our community, and benefit all of Roanoke.

clean_body: | | | Across the Commonwealth | | ~~ BILL TO ADDRESS SCHOOL CONSTRUCTION NEEDS ADVANCES Our schools are in desperate need of renovation and repair. Virginia voters should have the power to decide what best supports their students and schools, including whether to invest more in local public education. HB334, which has passed the House, puts that decision where it belongs: in the hands of local voters. By allowing a local referendum on a modest sales tax dedicated to school construction, HB334 gives communities another practical tool to address outdated school buildings and invest in safe, modern learning environments for our kids. BUDGET AMENDMENT FOR REDEVELOPMENT OF DOWNTOWN ROANOKE A casino is not the answer, but our city still needs investment. I have proposed a budget amendment requesting the Commonwealth invest $600,000 to analyze the redevelopment of downtown Roanoke, including hiring engineers to look at the older structures. This would include potential projects and pathways for the Roanoke Science Museum, Center in the Square, and land improvements around the Berglund Center complex. We must be creative to ensure that these investments leave a lasting positive impact on our community, and benefit all of Roanoke. | | DEL. **But this year is going to be different for three key reasons:**
**FIRST - I'm running against Tim Walz's right hand. All the rampant fraud that took place here happened under Peggy Flanagan's nose as much as it did under his. We will remind voters about that fact every single day. **
**SECOND - The President has increased his voter share each time he has run. He nearly flipped this state in the last election, and Kamala Harris' running mate was our sitting Governor! Momentum is on our side. **
**THIRD - I'm a different kind of candidate, and I know how to win. I didn't reach the top of my industry by pulling my punches. I put in the work. I never backed down. And I kept fighting, no matter what the naysayers said.**
**In my years on the sidelines, I 've seen a LOT of underdogs win football games that the "experts" said were impossible. **

clean_body: - Michele Tafoya here! I never really considered running for office. Ever. I was too focused on raising my family, and being the best football sideline reporter I could be. But even in the last few weeks, Minnesota has become the embodiment of everything wrong with politics today. Tim Walz, his inner circle, and the corrupt political class are too busy: Wasting billions of our tax dollars on fraudulent daycares Failing to condemn the activists storming churches Raising prices on hardworking families Sabotaging anything the President wants to do Forcing men into women's spaces Pitting Americans against each other I can 't sit on the sidelines anymore. That's why I'm throwing my hat in the ring and announcing my candidacy for U.S. Senate! thought long and hard about the dynamics of this race before jumping in. Minnesota has long been considered simply out of reach for Republicans. The last time it voted for a GOP President was Nixon. The pundits and political experts say a Republican could never win here. But this year is going to be different for three key reasons: FIRST - I'm running against Tim Walz's right hand. All the rampant fraud that took place here happened under Peggy Flanagan's nose as much as it did under his. We will remind voters about that fact every single day. SECOND - The President has increased his voter share each time he has run. He nearly flipped this state in the last election, and Kamala Harris' running mate was our sitting Governor! Momentum is on our side. THIRD - I'm a different kind of candidate, and I know how to win. I didn't reach the top of my industry by pulling my punches. I put in the work. I never backed down. And I kept fighting, no matter what the naysayers said. In my years on the sidelines, I 've seen a LOT of underdogs win football games that the "experts" said were impossible. The Minnesota Senate race will be another chapter in that storied history. | | ---|--- Thanks in advance for your support. I'll never forget the good folks who stepped up in the opening days of this campaign. You and I are going to do great things together. I can feel it. Be brave. Do good. - Michele Michele Tafoya Republican for Senate, Minnesota It's official - Michele Tafoya is running for U.S. Senate in Minnesota! Exciting news, Peter.
I just filed for re-election in Oregon’s Third Congressional District.
There is no time to waste. The people of Oregon’s Third District deserve a representative who doesn’t just listen to their concerns—but turns concerns into action. I’m grateful that every single day, I get to wake up and do just that. With your continued support, we will continue not just fighting back against Trump’s lawlessness, but lowering the cost of living, expanding access to affordable healthcare, and combating the climate crisis.
With your support, I made history as the only first-term Democrat in the House to pass a law in this Congress—and it was on behalf of our veterans. With you, I hosted more than 30 town halls, worked to release nine of our neighbors from ICE and CBP’s illegal detention, and put more than a million dollars back into the pockets of Oregonians.
I launched an investigation into one of Trump’s Department of the Interior officials. I brought articles of impeachment against Kristi Noem. And I helped found the Democratic Doctors Caucus to fight against RFK Jr.’s medical misinformation.
All of this was possible because of you.
These are difficult times. But Oregonians have proved over and over again that even when the Trump administration does everything they can to create chaos and mistrust, they cannot divide us. We choose peace. We choose hope. And we choose our neighbors.
This work isn’t over. That’s why I’m running for re-election—and why I’m asking you to stick by my side.
We’re less than six months out from the primary in May. I’m fighting to bring back compassion, accountability, and science to the House and Senate. Are you with me? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upl_med_email-26q1?refcode=x_260129_electionfiling_actrs]

subject: Charlie’s final book wasn’t about politics...
body:
[unsubscribe](https://trk.thedcbugle.com/?xul=65a6x69jow166jo1opkmvmi0w5g1mto481yjkhjw8jcvgs87njok41aw549meh6p2ov50op2qye0t0ve37h3njz9j0kezx9bs&__stmp=t9mya7&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh)
Please read the message below from our sponsor.
* * *
| | | [](https://trk.thedcbugle.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t9mya7&__onlt=h)
---
| | Friend,
---
| | Charlie would have wanted you to have this.

Before his September 10th assassination, Charlie had just put the finishing touches on a very important book. His final book.

The topic is one that Charlie found to be crucial for every human to understand and practice.

This isn’t a book about public policy or political discourse, nor is it simply about passing on values of patriotism to young Americans.

**Instead, this book is about something far deeper and more personal — the importance of honoring the Sabbath and resting in God’s grace.**

Despite his hectic schedule and full life, Charlie was committed to setting aside an entire day each week to rest, to pray, and to give undivided attention to God, Erika, and his children.

By honoring the Sabbath, Charlie lived out a powerful message: _**“God, You are enough. And because You are enough, I need not carry the weight of a world that was never mine to hold.”**_

His book, _**Stop, in the Name of God**_ is the fruit of that conviction.
---
[](https://trk.thedcbugle.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t9mya7&__onlt=h)
---
When you read it, you will hear Charlie’s voice inviting you to reclaim something our fast-paced culture has essentially erased: a time for rest, a time devoted to God, and time with family.

Charlie’s hope was for each of us to rediscover the Sabbath as he did: not as a burden to bear, but as a gift to receive...

A sacred routine meant to draw us nearer to God, to steady our hearts with His peace, and renew our strength for the battles to which He calls us.

I believe you will find this book inspiring.

Charlie wanted everyone to have this book because its message meant so much in his own life.

**[To claim your copy of this life-changing book, simply make a generous gift in any amount to Turning Point USA today.](https://trk.thedcbugle.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t9mya7&__onlt=h)**
---
[ **Support Turning Point USA**
**& Receive Charlie’s Final Book**](https://trk.thedcbugle.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t9mya7&__onlt=h)
---
In the months since Charlie’s assassination, there has been a massive surge of interest in Turning Point USA’s message among young Americans...

...and it’s not just the conservative message as a whole — _**it’s the message of FAITH!**_

In recent months, I have heard countless stories of people who have answered Charlie’s call to attend a Bible study, start a family, and pray to God.

Charlie devoted so much of his time urging people to build strong families, to go to church, and to stand up for America. _And it’s happening._

After years of witnessing declining church attendance, we are now seeing Americans filling the pews in huge numbers across the country.

What we’re witnessing is not just growth —**it’s revival.**

At Turning Point USA, we are dedicated and honored to continue strengthening the faith of Americans, young and old.

We are building a coalition of truth-preaching churches that stand firm against cultural compromise, defend biblical values, and strengthen families.

We are training pastors, uniting congregations, and, of course, reaching the next generation on campuses across the country with this same message.

You might feel disheartened by the evil in our culture and by the unthinkable assassination of Charlie.

**But America’s faithful are waking up. The youth are waking up. America is waking up.**

All across this nation, pastors are linking arms, young believers are finding their voice, and families are saying, _“We’re not backing down.”_

This is what Charlie prayed for.

I see this book as one of Charlie’s most enduring gifts to the world, and I know you will too.

None of us knew how brief his time on earth would be. But the truths written in this book are timeless. They will outlive us all, and most importantly, **_so will the legacy of Charlie’s faith._**

Charlie lived life at a relentless pace, but he also understood the sacred value of stillness. Through it all, his gaze was fixed on eternity with God.

**[To claim your copy of Charlie’s final book, simply make a gift, in any amount, to support Turning Point USA today.](https://trk.thedcbugle.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t9mya7&__onlt=h)**
---
[ **Support Turning Point USA**
**& Receive Charlie’s Final Book**](https://trk.thedcbugle.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t9mya7&__onlt=h)
---
I’ll personally ensure your copy is sent to you as soon as possible.

Thank you in advance for carrying on Charlie’s mission and supporting his legacy.
---
**For Charlie,**

**Justin Streiff**
Chief Operating Officer
Turning Point USA
---
[](https://trk.thedcbugle.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t9mya7&__onlt=h)
---
**[Support Turning Point USA](https://trk.thedcbugle.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t9mya7&__onlt=h)**
---
**P.S.** When you read **_Stop, in the Name of God,_** you will discover what Charlie found in the Sabbath: a holy rest that steadies the heart, renews the soul, and gives strength for the road ahead.

**[I hope you’ll claim your copy by making your most generous gift to Turning Point USA. Your support fuels our work to build the most faithful generation of Americans in history. Thank you, and God bless!](https://trk.thedcbugle.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t9mya7&__onlt=h)**

body:
| To accomplish everything we’re setting out to do, I need your support.
Derek --
I wanted you to be one of the first to hear the news: I’m running for governor of the state of Minnesota. **This is a home-grown campaign, born in a moment like no other.**
[**I’m going to tell you why in a moment. But first: Will you help us get off to a strong start by splitting a donation between Adam Schiff and my campaign?**](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=abs-em-klobuchar26.ucWei4&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_TAN_GEN_AC90_20260129_AM1_V1_S1&t=3&akid=9478%2E5257348%2EwoYebZ)

I’m not going to sugar coat it -- Minnesota has been through a lot.
The killings of two innocent Minnesotans. Three thousand ICE agents on our streets and in our towns, sent by an administration that relishes division. Minnesotans stood up. Our state has been the center of America’s heartbreak. But we have also been the center of America's courage and America's hope. In moments of enormous difficulty, we find strength in our Minnesota values of hard work, freedom, and simple decency and good will.
**These moments call for grit and resilience.** I’ve learned resilience from the people of Minnesota. They have stood up, they have marched, and they have brought food to their neighbors. Through it all we do not give up.
And grit? I learned that from my family. I’m the daughter of a newspaperman and a proud union member teacher. My grandpa worked 1500 feet underground in the mines on the Iron Range, and he saved his money in a coffee can in the basement to send my dad to college. I wouldn’t be where I am today without them.
**These times call for leaders who can stand up and not be rubber stamps of this administration.** But who are also willing to find common ground and fix things in our state.
I led our state’s biggest prosecutors’ office for eight years and then you gave me the honor of serving as your United States Senator. I was ranked number one in the Senate for bipartisan bills and number three out of one hundred for getting bills passed into law.
**I will do my job without fear or favor.** **I’ve never shied away from taking on the powerful. That’s what I did as prosecutor. That’s what I did as senator. And that’s what I will do as your governor.**
I believe we must stand up for what’s right. And fix what’s wrong. I am running for every Minnesotan who wants to buy their first home, for every parent who wants a better world for their kids, for everyone who wants more affordable healthcare. body:
You know me - I am not filling up your inbox four times a day with fundraising requests. So when they come, I hope you know they are important.

**These races matter.**
You know me - I am not filling up your inbox four times a day with fundraising requests. So when they come, I hope you know they are important.
Today, I am asking you to split a contribution between Amy Klobuchar's campaign for Governor in Minnesota and Aaron Ford's campaign for Governor in Nevada.
If you understand how important it is we have Democratic Governors in these states and are ready to contribute, just use this link to give right now.
[**https://act.gavinnewsom.com/go/klobuchar-ford**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/newsom-ford-klobuchar?refcode=ggn-260129&refcode2=2835_4767699_dIj5qL&akid=2835%2E4767699%2EdIj5qL)
Otherwise, please let me explain:
As people who pay attention to the news, it should be immediately obvious why it is so important for Minnesota to elect a Democratic governor in the next election.
Donald Trump and Stephen Miller are not people with some deep conviction about law and order. This is a President who failed to call up the National Guard when it was actually needed -- on January 6th -- and then pardoned the participants as one of his first acts as president.
They want spectacle. They want violence. They think -- or at least thought -- it was good for them politically. That's why White House aides posed pictures of Trump getting popcorn when he deployed the National Guard in California.
And in Minnesota, they got violence. Now two American citizens are dead. But even if ICE were to leave tomorrow, Minnesota has a lot of work to do to recover. And no one believes that is possible with a Republican governor -- a Trump lackey -- in charge.
Thankfully, Amy Klobuchar announced she is running to replace Tim Walz. She is a friend, she came to California during the Election Rigging Response Act, and it'd mean a lot to me if you could help her on day one.
Aaron Ford's race in Nevada obviously isn't getting the headlines, but it is no less important. This is a state with a Republican Governor who stands lock-step with President Trump at every turn.
And again, if there's anything Trump's law enforcement "surges" have taught us, it's how important it is states have Democratic governors to stand in the breach.
This is going to be one of the most competitive gubernatorial elections in the country -- a literal toss-up. It's also a place that is often overlooked when it comes to grassroots fundraising, so it's a chance to make a politically strategic donation that will go a long way.
I try not to send a billion emails ... but this one is important. Especially today.

It would mean a lot to me personally if you could support these two today -- especially today.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/newsom-ford-klobuchar?refcode=ggn-260129&refcode2=2835_4767699_dIj5qL&akid=2835%2E4767699%2EdIj5qL)

name: Karl for Congress
subject: Your Data is Being Weaponized
body:
[](https://karlforcongress.us/updates/97064032/)
---
#### Stop the ICE-Palantir Surveillance State
In a perfect storm of Orwellian dystopia, reports have confirmed that ICE is using a Palantir-developed AI tool to [scour Medicaid data to identify targets for arrest](https://link.karlforcongress.us/697925d5/ "Palantir/ICE connections draw fire as questions raised about tool tracking Medicaid data to find people to arrest"). The "_ELITE_ " app gets address information from the Department of Health and Human Services and uses it to map out areas for raids. In one fell swoop, a private corporation is misusing our unprotected personal data to target marginalized groups and make us all less safe, especially given the government's [dismal record of data security](https://link.karlforcongress.us/697928b5/ "The Trump administration admits even more ways DOGE accessed sensitive personal data"). This is only one of the many systems emerging from Palantir following their $30 million contract to build "_ImmigrationOS_ ", a platform to track immigrants with unprecedented scale. Regardless of the noise from some members of Congress about ICE's overreach, this relationship and the systems being developed will receive **zero scrutiny** because Congress is afraid to address the complexities of modern technology. There will be no oversight, no hearings, and this misuse of our private data will only expand. [On May 19, 2026, we can do something about it](https://link.karlforcongress.us/69613b1c/ "https://www.chestnuthilllocal.com/stories/the-path-forward-a-progressive-vision-for-the-3rd-district,39396")! On a related and disturbing note, it is deeply troubling that lawmakers, on both sides of the aisle, continue to profit from companies like Palantir while they are charged to provide oversight on their relationship with government agencies, such as ICE. Recent disclosures show that even Democrats, like Texas Representative Julie Johnson, [have traded thousands in Palantir stock](https://link.karlforcongress.us/697ab521/ "Anti-ICE Dem makes $4M trading stocks in Trump deportation contractor "), even while vocally criticizing ICE's actions. This isn't a partisan issue; it's a systemic failure. We can never be certain if our representatives are serving their constituents or their portfolios. To restore public trust, we must end this conflict of interest and [ban members of Congress from trading individual stocks](https://link.karlforcongress.us/697ab6d4/ " let's make insider trading illegal in Congress just like it is for the rest of us ").

The states of Washington and Oregon have become the first two states in America to start teaching gender identity to children as young as five, under the pretense of "health education." Olympia's recently enacted partisan "sex education bill" targets the pre-pubescent directly, requiring children in kindergarten and first grade to learn that "there are many ways to express gender," while second and third graders are taught that "there is a range of gender roles and expression."
Parents are rightfully outraged as wokeness enters their homes and the pre-pubescent level of children's education. Progressive democrat leaders and educators have defined gender as "a social construct based on emotional, behavioral, and cultural characteristics attached to a person's biological sex." Got it? Never mind what science teaches us about chromosomes and DNA; the indoctrination starts here.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack.com/redirect/2/eyJlIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9oZWFydGxhbmRqb3VybmFsLnN1YnN0YWNrLmNvbS9zdWJzY3JpYmU_.lhzm9Npyv070ndzYJRj20Cqk5rlMj0RGygrziIWrsDw?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=186199348)
Florida's Governor Ron DeSantis has taken a bold step for parental rights by passing the "Parental Rights in Education Bill," recently signed into law. This will prevent instruction on gender identity and sexual orientation to pre-pubescent and pre-adolescent children. Some cities and states have taken it a step further and made it a crime to teach what they deem "pornographic materials" to the same-aged children. Many on the left have called Florida's new law "unnecessary."
In Virginia, mother of six Stacy Langton testified at her school board meeting regarding the content of books in the publicly funded school library. Two books in particular were the target of her ire, "Lawn Boy and Gender Queen." "Both of these books include pedophilia," Langton told the Fairfax County school board. "One of the books describes sex between a fourth-grade boy and an adult male," decried Langton.
You can see why Dr. Seuss and Mr. Potato Head needed to be canceled.
In New Jersey, parents were shocked to read some of the texts being rolled out in September 2022. Like Washington and Oregon, the progressive-led state is also exposing these young children to sexual gratification, masturbation and anal stimulation unbeknownst to their parents. Many cities and states have now criminalized these materials from being taught to these children, utilizing laws already on the books meant to protect children this age.
These scholastic discoveries occurred during online learning, when parents were able to get a glimpse into the radical curriculum being taught. Critical race theory, transgenderism and Comprehensive Sexual Education (CSE) are the latest tools meant to place a wedge in the nuclear family and desensitize children, while removing the autonomy of the parents to raise their children as they see fit. The deconstruction of the American family and Western civilization is their intended goal.
Despite numerous studies showing these doctrines fail to achieve stated goals and result in increased sexual activity, schools are doubling down and devoting up to 70 hours of classroom time per child for sex education. The normalization of sex through (CSE) has now trickled down to the K-thru 3rd grade levels and advanced the radical sexual ideology in public schools; furthering the exploitation of children barely old enough to read.
Much of the so-called sex education content is teaching children to have many partners over the course of a lifetime, flying directly in the face of Judeo-Christian values and other faith views on marriage and sexuality. This is not the role of the public school system; it is the role of the parent. Elected school boards have the authority to refuse or rebut these teachings, but blue cities and states seem all too happy to acquiesce.
_God bless you, Vincent_

| | Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw
