Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18] | | | | | | Why In-the-Know Americans are PANICKING About Trump’s Latest Move With China | Many people believe Trump’s newest maneuver is... “...the boldest — and riskiest — foreign policy act by a U.S. President in a generation”... | | Sponsored Content | • | Salem Media Group ---|--- • | Priority Gold • | CardCritics | | | | | brоught tо уоu bу **Іnception Media, LLC. tо stоp rеcеiving mаrkеting cоmmunicаtiоn frоm us. January 29, 2026
The liberal media are portraying the protesters against ICE (United States Immigration and Customs Enforcement) as heroes while depicting ICE officers as Nazis and thugs. But who are the media and the protestors protecting?

They are protecting the likes of Ismalej-Gomez, an illegal from Guatemala who was living in Stamford, Connecticut, when he [broke the arm](https://substack.com/redirect/4d469ba9-c64b-4ff3-8538-06c166a2c776?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) of his six-month-old son, Liam Rivera. He was arrested and served sixty days of a five-year sentence with the requirement that he attend "parenting classes."

Apparently, he was not a particularly stellar student because two years later, he [smashed in the head](https://substack.com/redirect/a8961e6b-170d-4411-946c-a239f29d4932?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) of his two-year son, killing him, and stashed his body in a plastic bag.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/f5247b6d-38e1-4461-95c1-8ee28bc3779c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Liam Rivera who was killed by having his head smashed by an illegal.
In most other states, Ismalej-Gomez would have been turned over to ICE after breaking his son's arm and then deported.

But [Connecticut prohibits this](https://substack.com/redirect/222d51a2-822d-48ca-a8fe-1388799af0b4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). In 2019, the Democrats passed and Democratic Governor Ned Lamont signed [The Trust Act](https://substack.com/redirect/3f277f5f-a1b6-454e-8c0b-906919f8b624?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) which:

_Prohibit law enforcement officers from giving federal immigration authority access to interview an individual in custody unless:_
_(i) the individual has been convicted of a class A or B felony._
_(ii) the individual is identified as a possible match in the federal Terrorist Screening_
Since breaking a six-months-old arm is not a particularly heinous crime in Connecticut, especially if you are an illegal immigrant, Ismalej-Gomez was let loose. And now his son is dead.
The silence to Liam Rivera's death was deafening. There were no expressions of sympathy from Governor Lamont, Senators Murphy and Blumenthal or Congressman Jim Himes.

The poor child was just another expendable to the liberals who supported the Biden administration's policy of allowing the invasion of illegals into our country.
In fact**,** Connecticut [expanded the Trust Law](https://substack.com/redirect/224515c4-c75f-40fc-8304-d0574bef7e04?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in 2025 allowing illegals to sue if they are detained by ICE in violation of the initial Trust Law. Only in Connecticut would Ismalej-Gomez have the right to sue if an attempt was made to deport him after he broke his six-month-old son's arm.

But Connecticut liberals are still not satisfied. Many [recently protested](https://substack.com/redirect/cb78c95c-9aa0-4a47-ae33-c96e6bd775bf?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) against ICE in Bridgeport, Greenwich, New Haven and Hartford. Senator Blumenthal compared ICE [to Nazis](https://substack.com/redirect/11871d4d-4bbc-43fd-9e80-35193fbfc874?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). "
Perhaps these people have a legitimate point. The death of protestors Renee Good and Alex Pretti were tragic and possibly unnecessary. But Ms. Good was using her car to prevent ICE officials from doing their job and refused orders to get out of the car. Mr. Pretti was filming and berating ICE officials while having a loaded and visible Sig Sauer P320 9mm gun in his waist band. ICE workers and police sometimes have their lives flash before them and make split-second decisions that are second guessed by people whose idea of confrontation is arguing with their spouse whether to go the Caymen Islands or St. Bart's for vacation.
Furthermore, Liam Rivera's crime was simply existing in the wrong environment. Why aren't the liberals outraged by his death? Why aren't they protesting the sexual assault and murder of Laken Riley by an illegal immigrant? Or Rachel Morin, who was raped and murdered by an illegal while hiking? And on and on.

| Dear Fellow American,

Jeanne Hedgepeth was a longtime, tenured social studies teacher at Palatine High School in Illinois.
In the summer of 2020, _while off duty_ , Jeanne posted commentary on her personal Facebook page about the riots and unrest following the death of George Floyd.
**__And the school district fired Jeanne__**** _._**
Why? Because some outsiders—many of whom had no connection whatsoever to the school—complained about her posts.
**_Imagine this happening to you: Your career destroyed just for sharing your personal opinions_**** _about major political events._**
| [ DON’T GET ANGRY – TAKE ACTION ](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=79252&L=35348&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0yMTY/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUFNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249TWF5JnV0bV90ZXJtPU5vbi1Eb25vcnM=&hash=6b7d730242d55e52186759e44e828acf66566736e1bae6f943796970e61717b5)
---

As a leader in free speech litigation, **_Judicial Watch jumped in_** to defend Ms. Hedgepeth’s First Amendment rights by filing a federal civil rights lawsuit.

Recently, the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Seventh Circuit upheld the lower court’s ruling which deemed that Jeanne’s firing was legal despite clearly being based on _unconstitutional_ viewpoint discrimination.

**__In response,__**__**Judicial Watch has filed a petition****to the United States Supreme Court requesting they step in to review this important case**__ _._

_[Please support our Supreme Court petition by making a generous gift to fund this fight today—along with all our litigation defending American freedoms_](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=79252&L=30946&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0yMTYvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=aafc90fdace25a5a1871d30fa9a66413e29290f69056683c8a490d5fbaf2a4d2).

[ DEFEND FREE SPEECH – CONTRIBUTE NOW ](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=79252&L=35348&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0yMTY/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUFNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249TWF5JnV0bV90ZXJtPU5vbi1Eb25vcnM=&hash=6b7d730242d55e52186759e44e828acf66566736e1bae6f943796970e61717b5)
---

At stake is whether teachers and other public employees can be outright **_fired_** for political speech made **_privately_** , off duty and far removed from the classroom.

The Seventh Circuit’s decision **_poses a serious threat to the free speech of millions nationwide,_** as it teaches that lawful, off-duty speech on matters of public concern may be punished any time enough people simply complain.

**_This is why Judicial Watch has petitioned to take this fight to the Supreme Court of the United States._**

_[And it’s why I am asking you to make a tax-deductible first-time gift to Judicial Watch today to support our petition fighting for free speech](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=79252&L=30946&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0yMTYvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=aafc90fdace25a5a1871d30fa9a66413e29290f69056683c8a490d5fbaf2a4d2)_ —and fund the rest of our landmark litigative agenda.

[ FUEL OUR FIGHT FOR THE FIRST AMENDMENT ](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=79252&L=35348&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0yMTY/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUFNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249TWF5JnV0bV90ZXJtPU5vbi1Eb25vcnM=&hash=6b7d730242d55e52186759e44e828acf66566736e1bae6f943796970e61717b5)
---

Thank you for supporting Judicial Watch and **standing up for free speech**.

Sincerely,

Tom Fitton
President, Judicial Watch

P.S. This case is much bigger than one teacher. It goes to the heart of whether The First Amendment still protects 22 million public employees from being fired for daring to exercise their God-given First Amendment rights. _[Please make a first-time donation today to support our petition to The U.S. Supreme Court](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=79252&L=30946&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0yMTYvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=aafc90fdace25a5a1871d30fa9a66413e29290f69056683c8a490d5fbaf2a4d2)_ — and defend your rights in all our litigation.

[ MAKE A TAX-DEDUCTIBLE GIFT NOW ](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=79252&L=35348&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0yMTY/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUFNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249TWF5JnV0bV90ZXJtPU5vbi1Eb25vcnM=&hash=6b7d730242d55e52186759e44e828acf66566736e1bae6f943796970e61717b5)

Thug militias attacking citizens. Tariffs pushing prices sky-high. Healthcare premiums through the roof. While all of this is happening, my opponent refuses to put the interests of the American people before her own self-interest.

We need someone who isn’t afraid to put a check on an outlaw president, to defend our democracy, and to make sure that every American has a fair chance at prosperity.

| | Friend,
---
| | Charlie would have wanted you to have this.

Before his September 10th assassination, Charlie had just put the finishing touches on a very important book. His final book.

The topic is one that Charlie found to be crucial for every human to understand and practice.

This isn’t a book about public policy or political discourse, nor is it simply about passing on values of patriotism to young Americans.

**Instead, this book is about something far deeper and more personal — the importance of honoring the Sabbath and resting in God’s grace.**

Despite his hectic schedule and full life, Charlie was committed to setting aside an entire day each week to rest, to pray, and to give undivided attention to God, Erika, and his children.

By honoring the Sabbath, Charlie lived out a powerful message: _**“God, You are enough. And because You are enough, I need not carry the weight of a world that was never mine to hold.”**_

His book, _**Stop, in the Name of God**_ is the fruit of that conviction.
---
[](https://trk.greatamericandigest.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t9n2uu&__onlt=h)
---
When you read it, you will hear Charlie’s voice inviting you to reclaim something our fast-paced culture has essentially erased: a time for rest, a time devoted to God, and time with family.

Charlie’s hope was for each of us to rediscover the Sabbath as he did: not as a burden to bear, but as a gift to receive...

A sacred routine meant to draw us nearer to God, to steady our hearts with His peace, and renew our strength for the battles to which He calls us.

I believe you will find this book inspiring.

Charlie wanted everyone to have this book because its message meant so much in his own life.

**[To claim your copy of this life-changing book, simply make a generous gift in any amount to Turning Point USA today.](https://trk.greatamericandigest.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t9n2uu&__onlt=h)**
---

**& Receive Charlie’s Final Book**](https://trk.greatamericandigest.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t9n2uu&__onlt=h)
---
In the months since Charlie’s assassination, there has been a massive surge of interest in Turning Point USA’s message among young Americans...

...and it’s not just the conservative message as a whole — _**it’s the message of FAITH!**_

In recent months, I have heard countless stories of people who have answered Charlie’s call to attend a Bible study, start a family, and pray to God.

Charlie devoted so much of his time urging people to build strong families, to go to church, and to stand up for America. _And it’s happening._

After years of witnessing declining church attendance, we are now seeing Americans filling the pews in huge numbers across the country.

What we’re witnessing is not just growth —**it’s revival.**

At Turning Point USA, we are dedicated and honored to continue strengthening the faith of Americans, young and old.

We are building a coalition of truth-preaching churches that stand firm against cultural compromise, defend biblical values, and strengthen families.

We are training pastors, uniting congregations, and, of course, reaching the next generation on campuses across the country with this same message.

You might feel disheartened by the evil in our culture and by the unthinkable assassination of Charlie.

**But America’s faithful are waking up. The youth are waking up. America is waking up.**

All across this nation, pastors are linking arms, young believers are finding their voice, and families are saying, _“We’re not backing down.”_

This is what Charlie prayed for.

I see this book as one of Charlie’s most enduring gifts to the world, and I know you will too.

None of us knew how brief his time on earth would be. But the truths written in this book are timeless. They will outlive us all, and most importantly, **_so will the legacy of Charlie’s faith._**

Charlie lived life at a relentless pace, but he also understood the sacred value of stillness. Through it all, his gaze was fixed on eternity with God.

**[To claim your copy of Charlie’s final book, simply make a gift, in any amount, to support Turning Point USA today.](https://trk.greatamericandigest.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t9n2uu&__onlt=h)**

---
I’ll personally ensure your copy is sent to you as soon as possible.

Thank you in advance for carrying on Charlie’s mission and supporting his legacy.
---
**For Charlie,**

**Justin Streiff**
Chief Operating Officer
Turning Point USA

name: Justin Streiff, Turning Point USA
subject: The book Charlie left behind
body:
Please read the message below from our sponsor.
* * *
| | | [](https://trk.rightwingreport.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t9n2yh&__onlt=h)
---
| | Friend,
---
| | Charlie would have wanted you to have this.

Before his September 10th assassination, Charlie had just put the finishing touches on a very important book. His final book.

The topic is one that Charlie found to be crucial for every human to understand and practice.

This isn’t a book about public policy or political discourse, nor is it simply about passing on values of patriotism to young Americans.

**Instead, this book is about something far deeper and more personal — the importance of honoring the Sabbath and resting in God’s grace.**

Despite his hectic schedule and full life, Charlie was committed to setting aside an entire day each week to rest, to pray, and to give undivided attention to God, Erika, and his children.

By honoring the Sabbath, Charlie lived out a powerful message: _**“God, You are enough. And because You are enough, I need not carry the weight of a world that was never mine to hold.”**_

His book, _**Stop, in the Name of God**_ is the fruit of that conviction.
---
[](https://trk.rightwingreport.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t9n2yh&__onlt=h)
---
When you read it, you will hear Charlie’s voice inviting you to reclaim something our fast-paced culture has essentially erased: a time for rest, a time devoted to God, and time with family.

Charlie’s hope was for each of us to rediscover the Sabbath as he did: not as a burden to bear, but as a gift to receive...

A sacred routine meant to draw us nearer to God, to steady our hearts with His peace, and renew our strength for the battles to which He calls us.

I believe you will find this book inspiring.

Charlie wanted everyone to have this book because its message meant so much in his own life.

**[To claim your copy of this life-changing book, simply make a generous gift in any amount to Turning Point USA today.](https://trk.rightwingreport.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t9n2yh&__onlt=h)**
---
[ **Support Turning Point USA**
**& Receive Charlie’s Final Book**](https://trk.rightwingreport.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t9n2yh&__onlt=h)
---
In the months since Charlie’s assassination, there has been a massive surge of interest in Turning Point USA’s message among young Americans...

...and it’s not just the conservative message as a whole — _**it’s the message of FAITH!**_

In recent months, I have heard countless stories of people who have answered Charlie’s call to attend a Bible study, start a family, and pray to God.

Charlie devoted so much of his time urging people to build strong families, to go to church, and to stand up for America. _And it’s happening._

After years of witnessing declining church attendance, we are now seeing Americans filling the pews in huge numbers across the country.

What we’re witnessing is not just growth —**it’s revival.**

At Turning Point USA, we are dedicated and honored to continue strengthening the faith of Americans, young and old.

We are building a coalition of truth-preaching churches that stand firm against cultural compromise, defend biblical values, and strengthen families.

We are training pastors, uniting congregations, and, of course, reaching the next generation on campuses across the country with this same message.

You might feel disheartened by the evil in our culture and by the unthinkable assassination of Charlie.

**But America’s faithful are waking up. The youth are waking up. America is waking up.**

All across this nation, pastors are linking arms, young believers are finding their voice, and families are saying, _“We’re not backing down.”_

This is what Charlie prayed for.

I see this book as one of Charlie’s most enduring gifts to the world, and I know you will too.

None of us knew how brief his time on earth would be. But the truths written in this book are timeless. They will outlive us all, and most importantly, **_so will the legacy of Charlie’s faith._**

Charlie lived life at a relentless pace, but he also understood the sacred value of stillness. Through it all, his gaze was fixed on eternity with God.

**[To claim your copy of Charlie’s final book, simply make a gift, in any amount, to support Turning Point USA today.](https://trk.rightwingreport.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t9n2yh&__onlt=h)**
---
[ **Support Turning Point USA**
**& Receive Charlie’s Final Book**](https://trk.rightwingreport.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t9n2yh&__onlt=h)
---
I’ll personally ensure your copy is sent to you as soon as possible.

Thank you in advance for carrying on Charlie’s mission and supporting his legacy.
---
**For Charlie,**

**Justin Streiff**
Chief Operating Officer
Turning Point USA
---
[](https://trk.rightwingreport.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t9n2yh&__onlt=h)
---

# Microsoft's earnings shock tanks tech sector, markets, and crypto
U.S. stocks tumbled Thursday as **[Microsoft shares plunged over 10%](https://substack.com/redirect/eb081571-ae2a-4275-b8b4-f30dc1f80d87?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** despite beating earnings estimates, dragging the tech-heavy Nasdaq down 2.5%--its worst drop since October--and pulling the S&P 500 lower by about 1.5% amid investor worries over slowing cloud growth and surging AI capital spending.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/eb081571-ae2a-4275-b8b4-f30dc1f80d87?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Tech Drag Intensifies:** Nasdaq suffers steepest decline in months as Microsoft's sharp sell-off weighs heavily on the index and broader tech sector sentiment.
* **Cloud Growth Concerns:** Azure revenue growth slows to 38-39% from prior quarters, raising fears that AI investments may delay profitability.
* **Record Spending Alert:** Microsoft reports ballooning capital expenditures hitting new highs, fueling investor anxiety about long-term returns on massive AI infrastructure bets.
* **Mixed Mag7 Reactions:** While Microsoft sinks, other tech giants like Meta rise strongly post-earnings, highlighting divergent investor views on AI spending outcomes.

# Copper explodes to record high in metals frenzy
Copper prices **[surged to a stunning record high above $13,000 per ton](https://substack.com/redirect/bb27280f-250a-4a3c-9929-397f8c9b0cdf?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** Thursday, up nearly 10% in a single session, fueled by supply disruptions, U.S. tariff threats, and booming demand from AI data centers and electrification--joining gold and silver in 2026's explosive metals rally.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/bb27280f-250a-4a3c-9929-397f8c9b0cdf?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Tariff turmoil sparks surge:** President Trump's proposed 50% tariffs on copper imports triggered preemptive stockpiling in the U.S., draining global supplies and tightening markets in Europe and Asia despite later clarifications.
* **Supply shocks hit hard:** Major disruptions including earthquakes at Ivanhoe Mines' Kakula and mudflows at Freeport-McMoRan's Grasberg mine in Indonesia led to force majeure declarations and reduced output.
* **AI demand drives future:** Copper's critical role in data centers and AI infrastructure supports long-term growth, with global demand projected to jump from 28 million tons in 2025 to 42 million tons by 2040.
* **Rally deemed unsustainable:** Analysts warn speculative buying has pushed prices beyond fundamentals, with experts like StoneX predicting downward pressure as overdone positioning unwinds.

# Tesla axes iconic Model S, and X production forever
Tesla is **[ending production of its flagship Model S sedan and Model X SUV,](https://substack.com/redirect/135387dd-8fb2-4002-a375-1f2245082028?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** CEO Elon Musk announced Wednesday on the Q4 earnings call, as the company shifts Fremont factory lines to mass-produce Optimus humanoid robots in a bold pivot to an autonomous and robotics future. Buyers are urged to order now before the models vanish.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/135387dd-8fb2-4002-a375-1f2245082028?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Production Wind-Down Timeline:** Tesla will phase out Model S and X manufacturing next quarter, fully ending by mid-2026, with no direct replacements planned for these aging luxury EVs.
* **Factory Reallocation Strategy:** Fremont production lines are being replaced with a high-volume Optimus robot assembly capable of 1 million units annually to support Tesla's robotics ambitions.
* **Historical Significance Highlighted:** As Tesla's oldest models since 2012 (S) and 2015 (X), they represent the brand's early EV era but now account for just a tiny fraction of deliveries amid dominance by Model 3 and Y.
* **Strategic Shift Implications:** The move underscores Elon Musk's focus on autonomy, driverless tech, and humanoid robots over traditional vehicles, coinciding with Tesla's first annual revenue decline.

# Trump blasts Powell as moron over Fed rate hold
President Donald Trump on Thursday **[labeled Federal Reserve Chair Jerome Powell a"moron"](https://substack.com/redirect/e086b3e4-11ca-4119-8b0f-74fbf0b7c645?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** after the central bank held interest rates steady at 3.5% to 3.75%, defying calls for cuts amid claims inflation is no longer a threat and tariffs boost U.S. revenues. Trump accused Powell of costing the nation billions in unnecessary interest expenses.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/a2cb4987-dfb5-48e8-b662-39766db9c4f5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Trump escalates feud:** Renewed personal attacks include calling Powell "Too Late" and claiming high rates harm national security and economic growth.
* **Fed decision details** : Central bank paused rate cuts on January 28, 2026, citing solid economic expansion and somewhat elevated inflation despite Powell noting no major threat.
* **Trump demands action** : Insists U.S. deserves world's lowest rates due to tariff inflows, urging immediate substantial reductions to avoid massive interest costs.
* **Broader tensions rise** : Confrontation intensifies with DOJ probe into Powell, Supreme Court case on Fed removals, and hints at potential leadership changes.

* * *
# Starbucks revives loyalty tiers, as equitable rewards fail, superfans rejoice
Starbucks is **[bringing back tiered status to its Rewards program](https://substack.com/redirect/c8a9a86a-7db1-4761-87ec-783ed2a4b9a8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** starting March 10, aiming to better reward its most frequent customers who visit up to 200 times a year--previously treated the same as once-a-year visitors--as part of CEO Brian Niccol's turnaround push to boost visits and sales.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/c8a9a86a-7db1-4761-87ec-783ed2a4b9a8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Three-Tier Structure Unveiled:** Green (under 500 stars), Gold (500+ stars), and Reserve (2,500+ stars) levels launch March 10, with escalating perks like faster star earning and exclusive access.
* **Key Benefits Upgraded:** Gold and Reserve members get never-expiring stars, higher earn rates (1.2 or 1.7 stars per dollar), plus new options like Free Mod Mondays and a $2 discount at 60 stars.
* **Reverses 2019 Change:** Company scraps flat system from 2019 that equalized all members, acknowledging it failed to incentivize top loyalists amid broader efforts to drive frequent visits.
* **Loyalty Drives Revenue:** Program fuels 60% of U.S. sales through linked transactions, with active members hitting record highs as traffic grows for both Rewards and non-members.

subject: I’m running for governor of the state of Minnesota

body:
To accomplish everything we’re setting out to do, I need your support.

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/124293640/598165663/945413103?refcode=email_012926_klobuchar-split&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84NTY5MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlZjYwY2Y3Ni00M2ZkLWYwMTEtODMyZi0wMDBkM2ExZjBlNGMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=RIQ0mXFCAT2Ysg27vipsS080rwZTcYgobAm4M88UdEM=) Derek — I wanted you to be one of the first to hear the news: I’m running for governor of the state of Minnesota. **This is a home-grown campaign, born in a moment like no other.** [_**I’m going to tell you why in a moment. But first: Will you help us get off to a strong start by splitting a donation between Josh Shapiro and my campaign?**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/124293641/598165664/945413103?refcode=email_012926_klobuchar-split&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84NTY5MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlZjYwY2Y3Ni00M2ZkLWYwMTEtODMyZi0wMDBkM2ExZjBlNGMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=RIQ0mXFCAT2Ysg27vipsS080rwZTcYgobAm4M88UdEM=) I’m not going to sugar coat it — Minnesota has been through a lot. The killings of two innocent Minnesotans. Three thousand ICE agents on our streets and in our towns, sent by an administration that relishes division. Minnesotans stood up. Our state has been the center of America’s heartbreak. But we have also been the center of America's courage and America's hope. In moments of enormous difficulty, we find strength in our Minnesota values of hard work, freedom, and simple decency and good will. **These moments call for grit and resilience.** I’ve learned resilience from the people of Minnesota. They have stood up, they have marched, and they have brought food to their neighbors. Through it all we do not give up. And grit? I learned that from my family. I’m the daughter of a newspaperman and a proud union member teacher. My grandpa worked 1500 feet underground in the mines on the Iron Range, and he saved his money in a coffee can in the basement to send my dad to college. I wouldn’t be where I am today without them. **These times call for leaders who can stand up and not be rubber stamps of this administration.** But who are also willing to find common ground and fix things in our state. I led our state’s biggest prosecutors’ office for eight years and then you gave me the honor of serving as your United States Senator. I was ranked number one in the Senate for bipartisan bills and number three out of one hundred for getting bills passed into law. **I will do my job without fear or favor. I’ve never shied away from taking on the powerful. That’s what I did as prosecutor. That’s what I did as senator. And that’s what I will do as your governor.** I believe we must stand up for what’s right. And fix what’s wrong. I am running for every Minnesotan who wants to buy their first home, for every parent who wants a better world for their kids, for everyone who wants more affordable healthcare. I am running for every Minnesotan who wants to protect our democracy and get ICE and its abusive tactics out of the state we love. And I'm running for every student, farmer, dreamer and builder. _But to accomplish everything we’re setting out to do, I need your support._ **This campaign is for people who believe in something bigger than ourselves. For people who know that things have got to change.** [_**So please: Will you support my campaign for governor with a donation today? Your contribution will be split with Josh Shapiro.**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/124293642/598165665/945413103?refcode=email_012926_klobuchar-split&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84NTY5MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlZjYwY2Y3Ni00M2ZkLWYwMTEtODMyZi0wMDBkM2ExZjBlNGMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=RIQ0mXFCAT2Ysg27vipsS080rwZTcYgobAm4M88UdEM=) **I like my job in the Senate. But I love our state more than any job.** I love the people of Minnesota. And Minnesota, I want to be a transformative governor. Now is our moment to renew our commitment to the common good. I’m asking you to look up to the North Star and to see that there is a better future before us. To pursue good, we must believe that good will prevail. I know I do — and that’s why I’m asking you to join us. Amy

Voter Action Project [https://voteractionproject.org/]
Huffpost: Jeanine Pirro’s Cases Keep Falling Apart, And The Judges Have Had Enough [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/EA/EA007/1/89215/images/Huffpost_PirroDC.png]
Former Fox News host Jeanine Pirro was sworn in as the US attorney for the District of Columbia last year. The position of US Attorney for DC is important because it serves as both the federal prosecutor and the local district attorney in the nation's capital, often handling some of the most impactful cases across the country.
Pirro's qualifications for the job -- aside from serving as the elected district attorney for Westchester County in New York decades ago -- appeared to be her unwavering support of Donald Trump on TV and his claims about the 2020 election, which she repeated on air and was named a defendant in the cases Fox News settled with Dominion Voting Systems.
Now that she's in office, Pirro has seen a historically bad run of casework, including the felony assault charges she brought against a man who threw a sandwich at a Customs & Border Patrol agent who was part of Trump's DC takeover. A grand jury refused to indict him, and it's one of several examples of Pirro's office filing made-for-TV charges that have been thrown out.
We want to hear from voters in your area about her appointment. Will you take our one-click poll right away?

#

It’s Senator Mark Kelly.
Here’s the truth: Donald Trump and Pete Hegseth are abusing their authority to silence the voices that they find inconvenient — even when that speech is protected by the First Amendment.
That’s not just alarming, it's unconstitutional.
Now more than ever, we must hold them accountable.
And that starts with electing people to Congress who know what it means to serve our country and who will hold Trump and Hegseth accountable once in office.
**That’s why I’m proud to be supporting JoAnna Mendoza, the former Marine running to flip AZ-06 blue.**
Winning here is going to take all of us standing together. And as a fellow veteran, I know she has the grit and determination to get the job done and flip this seat.
The single most important thing you can do to ensure Jo has the resources she needs to win this race is to make a grassroots contribution today.

body:
#
Peter,
In case you missed it, the Governor sat down with MS NOW’s Jacob Soboroff last night for an exclusive interview.
When asked about working with Donald Trump and his administration to end their siege on the Twin Cities, Tim put it plainly: _“I know who I’m dealing with.”_
While Trump continues to fan the flames of hatred and misinformation on social media, Tim is focused on the job at hand and doing whatever he can to defend his state.

Even after all the things he’s done, and all the damage he has wrought, most of the media (with some great exceptions, to be sure) still treat Donald Trump like he’s a delicate crystal goblet, to be handled carefully, with voices at “whisper” setting, lest a strong exhalation shatter him. **[Tell the media it’s time to end this crap, and prioritize the truth over politeness.](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tcb5fc2f5-2032-48be-a724-eb1596a66e11/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)** **Trump is a liar. He lies constantly. He even lies about his lies.** And yet most of the media still can’t just come out and say it. They talk in euphemisms and weasel words, about “differences in opinion” or how the “president misspoke” or “did not agree” or “challenged the facts,” or anything else to avoid the inconvenient truth that our president is absolutely full of crap. **They are showing respect and deference to a man who deserves neither. He is a liar, and he needs to be called on that every time, for all to see.** His hardcore base may not care, but there are still a lot of people for whom the truth matters. And they need to know they are not alone when they defend reality. **[Tell the Media to just say “Trump is lying” and to stop using weasel words.](https://default.salsalabs.org/T6e010172-c5f7-4dbe-992e-93e38e8ade47/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)**

name: Shenna Bellows
subject: Weaponizing elections
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Democratic Association of Secretaries of State, Treasurer Denise Merrill
body:
| Hi there, Maine Secretary of State Shenna Bellows here. **Yesterday, the FBI raided the Fulton County, Georgia elections office – seizing ballots and election records from the 2020 presidential election.** Let that sink in. Years after Donald Trump lost in 2020, conspiracy theories about a “stolen election” are now being weaponized into raids by the FBI. And it’s why what’s happened here in Maine can’t be ignored. Beginning last summer, Trump’s Department of Justice sued me and the State of Maine to try to force us to hand over personal voter data. Let’s be clear about what this was: a blatant attempt to fuel conspiracy theories about our elections being stolen – and to pressure election officials into turning over sensitive voter information to advance a political narrative. I refused. As Maine’s Secretary of State, my job is to protect voters’ privacy and the integrity of our elections – not to help legitimize lies that undermine public trust. Handing over that data would have put Mainers at risk and set a dangerous precedent nationwide. What we’re seeing in Georgia is the logical next step when those lies go unchecked: election workers targeted, offices raided, and law enforcement used to keep false narratives alive, because Donald Trump can’t accept that he lost in 2020. The FBI just raided the Fulton County, Georgia election offices and seized boxes of ballots and vote tabulations related to the 2020 election.
Fulton County is the home to Atlanta and one of the biggest Democratic areas in the state. It was also the focal point for Trump's debunked election rigging conspiracy theory in the state.

This is how democracies collapse.
Democrats must double-down on efforts to defend and expand liberal majorities on state Supreme Courts in key states. These courts are the barrier to Trump's most insidious election rigging plots. The control over how elections are administered lies with states, not the federal government.
To secure future elections and ensure fairness, we cannot have Trump judges in place on key swing state courts that could issue decisions in favor of MAGA in states where it matters most.
That's the mission of Defend Our Courts.
We saw what was coming early and got ahead of Trump's election rigging scheme. We already helped defend the liberal majority in PA in 2025, now AZ, MI, GA, and WI all have state Supreme Court seats on the ballot in 2026.

Just days after murdering Alex Pretti, and weeks after murdering Renee Good, federal immigration agents are still threatening to take more lives. One agent told a protester, “You raise your voice, I erase your voice.”
[](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/4823?t=2&akid=2058%2E791427%2EKULLph)
They have continued brutalizing protesters, too. One man was tackled to the ground by Border Patrol agents, and despite being subdued, was pepper-sprayed directly in the face at point-blank range, which can cause permanent eye damage and blindness.
[](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/4825?t=3&akid=2058%2E791427%2EKULLph)
In Minneapolis, ICE agents tried to enter the Ecuadorian consulate, which is illegal under international law. Consulate staff had to physically block the agents, who were threatening to use force to enter. DHS lied about the incident afterwards and said they have “no record of ICE or Border Patrol being at the location.”
[](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/4827?t=4&akid=2058%2E791427%2EKULLph)
Selamawit Mehari, a legal immigrant with refugee status who lives in St. Paul, was visited by ICE and swiftly taken away. Her children produced paperwork proving their mother was in the country lawfully. ICE ignored them, shackled Selamawit, and flew her to a detention center in Texas. Days later, they released her in Texas with nothing but the shirt on her back. Family and friends had to help her get back home to Minnesota.
This isn’t an isolated incident either — according to the New York Times, more than 100 refugees have been arrested in Minnesota and taken away in shackles, only to be released with no way home.
[](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/4837?t=5&akid=2058%2E791427%2EKULLph)
And honestly friend, these injustices are not just taking place in Minnesota.
In Texas, ICE detained a father named Maher Tarabishi at a routine immigration check-in. Maher is the primary caretaker of his disabled son, Wael. The family pleaded with ICE, explaining that Wael’s health was quickly declining. Wael died within weeks. ICE didn’t even allow Maher to lay his son to rest under supervised release.
[](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/4859?t=6&akid=2058%2E791427%2EKULLph)_Wael and Maher Tarabishi_
Just like Minneapolis, ICE has targeted the Somali-American community in Maine. But just like in Minneapolis, residents are observing, documenting, and protesting their reckless behavior. According to ICE, that makes you a “domestic terrorist”, the same label used to justify the murders of Renee Good and Alex Pretti:
[](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/4863?t=7&akid=2058%2E791427%2EKULLph)
What’s happening across the country right now is a dire Constitutional crisis: an all-out assault on the rule of law and civil rights by out-of-control government thugs that face zero accountability.
I’m calling on all of us to stand with Minnesota and every community today to help us fight back against ICE’s crackdowns. We cannot let them get away with terrorizing our neighbors and beating and killing people in the streets.

Former Illinois State Sen. Darren Bailey. (Tribune News Service via Getty Images)
By Illinois Review

A new survey of likely Republican primary voters shows former state Sen. Darren Bailey expanding his lead in the 2026 Illinois Republican primary for governor, reinforcing findings from an earlier major poll released by WGN-TV.

The latest poll, conducted by Osage Research, finds Bailey supported by 57 percent of likely Republican primary voters. Businessman Rick Heidner registered at 9 percent, Ted Dabrowski at 8 percent, and DuPage County Sheriff James Mendrick at 4 percent. Another 23 percent of respondents remain undecided.

Bailey’s margin represents a 49-point advantage over his nearest competitor and exceeds the combined support of the rest of the field.
https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2026/01/new-poll-confirms-baileys-dominance-as-gop-primary-continues-to-consolidate.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=4570c59450-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-666344823
The Osage Research findings follow the first major public poll of the race, commissioned by WGN-TV and conducted by Emerson College Polling in early January. That survey showed Bailey leading with 34.4 percent, compared with Dabrowski at 8.2 percent, Mendrick at 5.4 percent, and Heidner at 1.1 percent, with 46.4 percent undecided.

Taken together, the two polls suggest a consistent pattern: Bailey has maintained a substantial lead over the field while increasing his share of committed support as undecided voters shrink.

* * *
_**By David Shuster**_
The demand itself was chilling. The timing made it obscene.
On Saturday, after federal agents shot and killed Alexander Pretti, a 37-year-old ICU nurse, Trump attorney General Pam Bondi did not announce an independent investigation. She did not express accountability. Instead, Bondi reached out to Minnesota officials to make demands.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/25895f6d-deaa-4b2d-bb2d-0e59353bfedc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
The killing, say the Trumpsters, was not the fault of the federal agents who repeatedly shot Pretti in the back while holding him on the ground. Nor, say the MAGATs, was this execution the fault of the federal Trump machinery that empowered the agents. Instead, according to Bondi's theology, this was the fault of Minnesota.
And absolution was available--for a price.
That price was not modest. Bondi invited the state was to surrender Medicaid and SNAP records, dismantle sanctuary policies already found by the courts to be legal, hand over undocumented prisoners, and deliver up Minnesota voter rolls to the Department of Justice. In return, Bondi implied, federal forces might "bring an end to the chaos."
* * *
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack.com/redirect/2/eyJlIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuYmx1ZWFtcC5jby9zdWJzY3JpYmU_.P5LqEzz9CW_98NZ1Md7EoKdOoN4jDgItkGsYIZ7ZE2g?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=185901340)
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/25895f6d-deaa-4b2d-bb2d-0e59353bfedc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
"Chaos" in this context means the killings of two ICE observers in two weeks. Bondi's own department has declined to investigate either. The first incident, the shooting death of Renee Good, was so stark and the cover-up so intense, that it drove an FBI field officer supervisor to resign.
Bondi's demands were not governance. This was ransom.
Minnesota Secretary of State Steve Simon responded plainly: "The answer to Attorney General Bondi's request is no."
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/25895f6d-deaa-4b2d-bb2d-0e59353bfedc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
It had to be no. Because voter rolls are not a courtesy file to be passed around when a White House wants leverage. They are protected by state law. And they are protected for a reason. State voter rolls contain sensitive personal information--names, addresses, dates of birth, voting history--and in some cases partial identifying numbers. On their own, that data is powerful. Combined with federal databases the Trump administration already controls, it could become something else entirely: a master key.
With voter rolls in hand, a hostile Trump administration could cross-reference voters against immigration databases, tax records, benefit programs, and Social Security files.
* * *
[Share](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=3722532&post_id=185901340&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email&utm_content=share&utm_campaign=email-share&action=share&triggerShare=true&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTg1OTAxMzQwLCJpYXQiOjE3Njk3MTg0NjUsImV4cCI6MTc3MjMxMDQ2NSwiaXNzIjoicHViLTM3MjI1MzIiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.bqfdap882ErkCqjuVz7EmvRj_Tb2Z9eCBbPdbOqDSdE)
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/25895f6d-deaa-4b2d-bb2d-0e59353bfedc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Even when full Social Security numbers are not listed on voter rolls, matching across systems can easily reconstruct identities, family relationships, and economic profiles. This is not security. It is surveillance.
And surveillance has consequences. It can be used to intimidate voters. To challenge registrations en masse. To selectively purge rolls. To target political opponents. To chill participation in elections--especially among immigrants, communities of color, and anyone already wary of federal power.
This is not hypothetical. The Trump movement has spent years trying to delegitimize elections it does not win, searching for pretexts to seize control of election infrastructure from the states.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/25895f6d-deaa-4b2d-bb2d-0e59353bfedc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Bondi's demand fits squarely within that outrageous effort. What makes it extraordinary now is the coercion: voter data as payment in exchange for the withdrawal of federal agents who are already trampling on the constitution, throwing out due process, and literally killing people for exercising first amendment rights.
As Simon noted, Minnesota is not alone in refusing to turn over voter rolls. Thirty-one states--red and blue--have refused similar requests. That's because the law does not permit it. The Constitution does not permit it. Still, the idea that a U.S. Attorney General would treat public safety as a bargaining chip should alarm every American, regardless of party or political persuasion.
* * *
[Leave a comment](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=3722532&post_id=185901340&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email&isFreemail=true&comments=true&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTg1OTAxMzQwLCJpYXQiOjE3Njk3MTg0NjUsImV4cCI6MTc3MjMxMDQ2NSwiaXNzIjoicHViLTM3MjI1MzIiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.bqfdap882ErkCqjuVz7EmvRj_Tb2Z9eCBbPdbOqDSdE&r=1hvr60&utm_campaign=email-half-magic-comments&action=post-comment)
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/25895f6d-deaa-4b2d-bb2d-0e59353bfedc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
"It is deeply disturbing," Simon wrote, "that the U.S. Attorney General would make this unlawful request a part of an apparent ransom to pay for our state's peace and security."
That is the correct word: ransom.
If the federal government was involved in a crime in Minnesota, the U.S. Department of Justice has a duty to investigate the agents --not to strong-arm state officials into surrendering unrelated personal data. If the Trump administration actually believes in democracy, it should protect voters, not compile dossiers on them.
And if Pam Bondi wants peace, she should help end what Minnesota officials have rightly called "the unprecedented and deadly occupation" of their state--an occupation now defined not only by force, but by extortion.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/25895f6d-deaa-4b2d-bb2d-0e59353bfedc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
This is not law and order. It is power demanding submission.
Minnesota said no. The rest of the country should be grateful--and ready to say no too.
When a government treats public safety as a bargaining chip and voter information as a spoil of conquest, the problem is not just the violence and chaos of federal agents in the streets. The problem is also the rot the at the core of the Trump administration.

The Trump DOJ's attempt to trade peace for voter surveillance crosses a red line | | and | Jan 29 | | | ---|---|--- | | | | | | | | | | | | | ---|---|--- | | ---|---|--- Blue Amp Media is a reader-supported publication. To receive new posts and support my work, consider becoming a free or paid subscriber. By David Shuster The demand itself was chilling. The timing made it obscene. On Saturday, after federal agents shot and killed Alexander Pretti, a 37-year-old ICU nurse, Trump attorney General Pam Bondi did not announce an independent investigation. She did not express accountability. Instead, Bondi reached out to Minnesota officials to make demands. | | ---|---|--- The killing, say the Trumpsters, was not the fault of the federal agents who repeatedly shot Pretti in the back while holding him on the ground. Nor, say the MAGATs, was this execution the fault of the federal Trump machinery that empowered the agents. Instead, according to Bondi's theology, this was the fault of Minnesota. And absolution was available--for a price. That price was not modest. Bondi invited the state was to surrender Medicaid and SNAP records, dismantle sanctuary policies already found by the courts to be legal, hand over undocumented prisoners, and deliver up Minnesota voter rolls to the Department of Justice. In return, Bondi implied, federal forces might "bring an end to the chaos." | | ---|---|--- "Chaos" in this context means the killings of two ICE observers in two weeks. Bondi's own department has declined to investigate either. The first incident, the shooting death of Renee Good, was so stark and the cover-up so intense, that it drove an FBI field officer supervisor to resign. Bondi's demands were not governance. This was ransom. Minnesota Secretary of State Steve Simon responded plainly: "The answer to Attorney General Bondi's request is no." | | ---|---|--- It had to be no. Because voter rolls are not a courtesy file to be passed around when a White House wants leverage. They are protected by state law. And they are protected for a reason. State voter rolls contain sensitive personal information--names, addresses, dates of birth, voting history--and in some cases partial identifying numbers. On their own, that data is powerful. Combined with federal databases the Trump administration already controls, it could become something else entirely: a master key. With voter rolls in hand, a hostile Trump administration could cross-reference voters against immigration databases, tax records, benefit programs, and Social Security files. | | ---|---|--- Even when full Social Security numbers are not listed on voter rolls, matching across systems can easily reconstruct identities, family relationships, and economic profiles. This is not security. It is surveillance. And surveillance has consequences. It can be used to intimidate voters. To challenge registrations en masse. To selectively purge rolls. To target political opponents. To chill participation in elections--especially among immigrants, communities of color, and anyone already wary of federal power. This is not hypothetical. The Trump movement has spent years trying to delegitimize elections it does not win, searching for pretexts to seize control of election infrastructure from the states. | | ---|---|--- Bondi's demand fits squarely within that outrageous effort. What makes it extraordinary now is the coercion: voter data as payment in exchange for the withdrawal of federal agents who are already trampling on the constitution, throwing out due process, and literally killing people for exercising first amendment rights. As Simon noted, Minnesota is not alone in refusing to turn over voter rolls. Thirty-one states--red and blue--have refused similar requests. That's because the law does not permit it. The Constitution does not permit it. Still, the idea that a U.S. Attorney General would treat public safety as a bargaining chip should alarm every American, regardless of party or political persuasion. | | ---|---|--- "It is deeply disturbing," Simon wrote, "that the U.S. Attorney General would make this unlawful request a part of an apparent ransom to pay for our state's peace and security." That is the correct word: ransom. If the federal government was involved in a crime in Minnesota, the U.S. Department of Justice has a duty to investigate the agents --not to strong-arm state officials into surrendering unrelated personal data. If the Trump administration actually believes in democracy, it should protect voters, not compile dossiers on them. And if Pam Bondi wants peace, she should help end what Minnesota officials have rightly called "the unprecedented and deadly occupation" of their state--an occupation now defined not only by force, but by extortion. | | ---|---|--- This is not law and order. It is power demanding submission. Minnesota said no. The rest of the country should be grateful--and ready to say no too. When a government treats public safety as a bargaining chip and voter information as a spoil of conquest, the problem is not just the violence and chaos of federal agents in the streets. The problem is also the rot the at the core of the Trump administration. Take a whiff. The stench is getting worse. | | ---|---|--- READ MORE BLUE AMP MEDIA | | and | | ---|---|--- | Jan 28 | | | and | | * ---|---|--- | Jan 27 | Invite your friends and earn rewards If you enjoy Blue Amp Media, share it with your friends and earn rewards when they subscribe. | | | | | | | (C) 2026 Cliff Schecter PO Box 8384, Cincinnati, OH 45208 ? ?

body:
# [](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/43706?t=1&akid=240650%2E444211%2EVIeLn-)
I arrived at the University of Houston Downtown campus just before 11am to join our volunteers for a full day of registration and action.
UHD is a really special place. It is the often-overlooked sister institution to the University of Houston main campus. But it is its own place. Separate mascot (Gator, not Cougar), different student body (more Houston-based, fewer students from other parts of the state) and a real drive to prove itself on its own terms.
For the next four hours, we met, registered and—importantly!—committed to staying in touch with every student we met. As you know, our organizing model is different from any other out there. Our volunteers maintain personal contact with the voters they meet for the duration of the election year, ready to answer questions on voter ID, election dates, candidates and also there to prompt, nudge and push these voters to cast those ballots. In 2024, the young voters in our network turned out at a rate of 79.5%!
[](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=pbp-em-20260129-1.F-Lme_&refcode=ema20260129-240650&t=3&akid=240650%2E444211%2EVIeLn-)
[](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=pbp-em-20260129-1.F-Lme_&refcode=ema20260129-240650&t=4&akid=240650%2E444211%2EVIeLn-)
[](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=pbp-em-20260129-1.F-Lme_&refcode=ema20260129-240650&t=5&akid=240650%2E444211%2EVIeLn-)
And this isn't a transaction. It's personal for us. We take the time to introduce ourselves, ask the students their names, understand their concerns, answer their questions and listen to their stories. I learned a lot yesterday by doing just that. These young Texans told me about their lives, how in many cases they are the first in their family to go to college, how they live in mixed immigration status families that are afraid to go out in public, and concerned about what it will mean for them to be registered and to vote.
I met a young man who was picking up his diploma and was there with his mom. He's a U.S. citizen and she's a legal permanent resident. But not only has she produced this recent graduate, one of her daughters was her high school's valedictorian and is now at Duke and the other finished top three in her class and is attending Vanderbilt. She, and so many others that I met at UHD, underscore the fact that immigrants make this country great.
At 3pm we started a town hall program, open to all students, faculty and staff, organized by the UHD Democrats. In front of a full house I had the opportunity to make my case for doing more than just voting to overcome the challenges we face. It's going to take the kind of organizing work that we're doing at UHD and all across the state. I asked these students to join us as volunteers, and many answered the call. I also had the chance to hear their questions and share my perspective on a range of issues—gerrymandering, immigration, ICE, and how we can persuade people who voted for Trump, and now might be feeling some remorse, to join the effort to save our country.
[](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=pbp-em-20260129-1.F-Lme_&refcode=ema20260129-240650&t=6&akid=240650%2E444211%2EVIeLn-)
After grabbing a quick bite (Nua Thai—really good!), I met our volunteers for a happy hour at Axlerad's. After a big, long day of meeting, registering, and talking with students it was fun to share stories, get to know each other a little better and meet some of our newer volunteers.
[](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=pbp-em-20260129-1.F-Lme_&refcode=ema20260129-240650&t=7&akid=240650%2E444211%2EVIeLn-)
Our tally at the end of the day was 251 conversations with students, each of those students agreeing to let our volunteers stay in touch with them to help them vote. We _verified registrations for 185 and registered or updated registration for 66_. And remember, that's just one day, on one campus. Our volunteers and organizers are in every part of the state doing this work every day. I could tell that everyone felt exhausted, but the good kind of exhaustion, where you know that what you did has made a difference. In the face of so much that is so wrong in the country right now, knowing that we are helping change things for the better—one voter at a time—feels pretty good.
As I write this, we are about to leave for another full day of voter registration work on the Prairie View A&M; campus in Waller County, about an hour from Houston. I'm looking forward to it and grateful that we get to do this work.
Thank you for supporting us and keeping us going.
Beto

Emily Randall for Congress
Peter,
Last week, I was in the Twin Cities for the memorial of Renee Nicole Good and a hearing with local officials about ICE. Now, DHS agents have killed another person, Alex Pretti, in the streets.
I’m heartbroken and angry, and I’m taking every action I can to hold ICE accountable:
• I co-introduced _**[Articles of Impeachment](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/124298855/598181415/308985175?refcode=RS_EM_EN_2026.01.29_HopeYoureHoldingUp&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDIvMS82NzI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1OTk3MDNiNi00ZGZkLWYwMTEtODMyZi0wMDBkM2ExZjBlNGMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=9ZYub9M5Mekb12JqLif-aXHW-HR67TX8ewM1kpOjJ30=&emci=7c64fe1c-4afd-f011-832f-000d3a1f0e4c&emdi=599703b6-4dfd-f011-832f-000d3a1f0e4c&ceid=23483442)**_ against DHS Secretary Kristi Noem. (160+ Democrats have now signed on!)
• I’m calling for full accountability and prosecution of immigration agents who commit crimes – NO qualified immunity for state-sanctioned violence.
• I voted F*** NO on the _**[DHS funding package](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/124298856/598181416/562436179?hl=en&refcode=RS_EM_EN_2026.01.29_HopeYoureHoldingUp&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDIvMS82NzI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1OTk3MDNiNi00ZGZkLWYwMTEtODMyZi0wMDBkM2ExZjBlNGMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=9ZYub9M5Mekb12JqLif-aXHW-HR67TX8ewM1kpOjJ30=&emci=7c64fe1c-4afd-f011-832f-000d3a1f0e4c&emdi=599703b6-4dfd-f011-832f-000d3a1f0e4c&ceid=23483442)**_ , and I urge every member of the Senate to reject it as well. No Democrat – no human – should vote to fund this terror.
I’m so grateful for the Minnesotans helping their neighbors while monitoring ICE with whistles and cameras. I’m thankful for all of you making calls, sending money via [_**StandWithMinnesota.com**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/124298857/598181417/1478115048?refcode=RS_EM_EN_2026.01.29_HopeYoureHoldingUp&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDIvMS82NzI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1OTk3MDNiNi00ZGZkLWYwMTEtODMyZi0wMDBkM2ExZjBlNGMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=9ZYub9M5Mekb12JqLif-aXHW-HR67TX8ewM1kpOjJ30=&emci=7c64fe1c-4afd-f011-832f-000d3a1f0e4c&emdi=599703b6-4dfd-f011-832f-000d3a1f0e4c&ceid=23483442), and doing what you can from afar.
Please also remember to rest, drink water, and take breaks from scrolling. These days take an emotional, mental, and physical toll. Take care of yourself and each other.
More updates soon – thank you 💙
– Emily
P.S. As I write this, Border Patrol commander Greg Bovino has just been demoted and dismissed from Minneapolis. Trump is also withdrawing some agents from the city. Our pressure is working – thanks for everything you do.

was attacked at a town hall in Minneapolis Tuesday night.

We hosted a town hall to discuss ICE’s ongoing, violent occupation of our
city. As Ilhan was giving her remarks, a man rushed up to her and squirted
her with an unknown substance from a syringe. Thankfully, our security
team apprehended him immediately.

take questions from her constituents. We don’t let bullies win.

This administration is tearing the Constitution apart and killing people

name: Amy Klobuchar
subject: I’m running for governor of the state of Minnesota
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Minnesotans for Klobuchar
body:
To accomplish everything we’re setting out to do, I need your support.

[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/kdh-fftp-klobuchar?refcode=em260129&refcode2=928_2563979_SjaV0h&akid=928%2E2563979%2ESjaV0h)
Peter --
I wanted you to be one of the first to hear the news: I’m running for governor of the state of Minnesota. **This is a home-grown campaign, born in a moment like no other.**
[**I’m going to tell you why in a moment. But first: Will you help us get off to a strong start by splitting a donation between Kamala Harris’s Fight for the People PAC and my campaign?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/kdh-fftp-klobuchar?refcode=em260129&refcode2=928_2563979_SjaV0h&akid=928%2E2563979%2ESjaV0h)
I’m not going to sugar coat it -- Minnesota has been through a lot.
The killings of two innocent Minnesotans. Three thousand ICE agents on our streets and in our towns, sent by an administration that relishes division. Minnesotans stood up. Our state has been the center of America’s heartbreak. But we have also been the center of America's courage and America's hope. In moments of enormous difficulty, we find strength in our Minnesota values of hard work, freedom, and simple decency and good will.
**These moments call for grit and resilience.** I’ve learned resilience from the people of Minnesota. They have stood up, they have marched, and they have brought food to their neighbors. Through it all we do not give up.
And grit? I learned that from my family. I’m the daughter of a newspaperman and a proud union member teacher. My grandpa worked 1500 feet underground in the mines on the Iron Range, and he saved his money in a coffee can in the basement to send my dad to college. I wouldn’t be where I am today without them.
**These times call for leaders who can stand up and not be rubber stamps of this administration.** But who are also willing to find common ground and fix things in our state.
I led our state’s biggest prosecutors’ office for eight years and then you gave me the honor of serving as your United States Senator. I was ranked number one in the Senate for bipartisan bills and number three out of one hundred for getting bills passed into law.
**I will do my job without fear or favor. I’ve never shied away from taking on the powerful. That’s what I did as prosecutor. That’s what I did as senator. And that’s what I will do as your governor.**
I believe we must stand up for what’s right. And fix what’s wrong. I am running for every Minnesotan who wants to buy their first home, for every parent who wants a better world for their kids, for everyone who wants more affordable healthcare. I am running for every Minnesotan who wants to protect our democracy and get ICE and its abusive tactics out of the state we love.
And I'm running for every student, farmer, dreamer and builder.
_But to accomplish everything we’re setting out to do, I need your support._
**This campaign is for people who believe in something bigger than ourselves. For people who know that things have got to change.**
[**So please: Will you support my campaign for governor with a donation today? Your contribution will be split with Kamala Harris’s Fight for the People PAC.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/kdh-fftp-klobuchar?refcode=em260129&refcode2=928_2563979_SjaV0h&akid=928%2E2563979%2ESjaV0h)
**[DONATE](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/kdh-fftp-klobuchar?refcode=em260129&refcode2=928_2563979_SjaV0h&akid=928%2E2563979%2ESjaV0h)**
**I like my job in the Senate. But I love our state more than any job.** I love the people of Minnesota. And Minnesota, I want to be a transformative governor.
Now is our moment to renew our commitment to the common good. I’m asking you to look up to the North Star and to see that there is a better future before us.
To pursue good, we must believe that good will prevail. I know I do -- and that’s why I’m asking you to join us.
Amy

name: Major General Paul Eaton, U.S. Army, Ret.
subject: A brief story about de-escalation
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY VOTEVETS, VOTEVETS
body:
It’s a small town outside of Fallujah, at the height of the Iraq War. A rifle battalion commander and his men are outfitted in battle dress. A crowd of Iraqis approach these men, very upset, with a whole lot of riot potential. An exceptionally dangerous situation.
#
After months of unjustified and outrageous escalations from Trump’s paramilitary forces, I’ve got a story for you.
It’s a small town outside of Fallujah, at the height of the Iraq War. A rifle battalion commander and his men are outfitted in battle dress. A crowd of Iraqis approaches these men, very upset, with a whole lot of riot potential. An exceptionally dangerous situation.
That battalion commander did not square up for a fight. He directed his men to take a knee, put the barrels of their rifles in the dirt, and smile. His men thought he was crazy, but they followed orders. And in one fell swoop, everything de-escalated. The Iraqis didn’t riot, no one was shot, and everybody went home.
A rifle battalion commander, surrounded by young men, in a combat zone, acted with restraint. What we’ve seen these last several weeks on American streets has been anything but restrained.
I don’t tell you this to advocate pitting American Troops against American citizens, but to further illustrate the vast divide between our Military and the ICE and CBP agents deployed by Trump to stir up trouble.
They’re out looking for a fight, and it’s important to understand why. He had Pam Bondi demand access to the Minnesota voter rolls in exchange for a drawdown. The FBI just raided an elections office in Fulton County, Georgia.
Trump knows the country hates what he’s doing. He knows he’s going to get taken to the woodshed this November. And he’s trying to figure out any way he can to hold on to power — even if he loses.
We’ve already seen it on January 6th, 2021. We see it every day in the lies, provocations, and threats Trump makes. This is an incredibly serious situation, and we can’t wait to act against it.
VoteVets is working day after day to reach and turn out millions of Veterans around the country to defend our democracy this November. We can’t just win these elections — we have to make our victories absolutely undeniable.
That work has already begun, and it doesn’t stop until we get the final count for the House and Senate once all of the votes are in.
